apps.description: Independent AirSIM client for Cardputer Zero. Make and answer calls, send and receive SMS, use two-way call audio, and view device battery, unread messages and missed-call numbers. Includes local contacts, call records, SIM selection and DTMF. apps.title: amiibo_sim
apps.summary: Amiibo模拟器
apps.description:
1、项目介绍
使用Cap CC1101内置的 ST25R3916 NFC 芯片，模拟Amiibo，支持刷新随机UID
.bin文件需由用户自行添加至~/amiibo_sim

2、准备工作

- 关机装好 Cap CC1101，开机后在 `Settings → ExtPort` 中确认 EXT D+/D− 处于 GPIO 模式。
- 从 APPLaunch 打开 `amiibo_sim`。如果屏幕显示 `NFC SPI missing` 或 `SPI access denied`，需运行：
sudo /usr/lib/amiibo_sim/cap-setup

应用只检测 SPI 状态。上面的命令由用户授权执行，负责加载 NFC SPI 配置并设置设备访问权限。应用会自动复查，也可以按 H 立即检查。看到 CAP ST25R3916 connected 即可选卡。临时加载的 SPI 配置在重启后需要重新启用。
- 应用会尝试自动开启 EXT 5V。如果显示 EXT 5V failed，需在 Settings → ExtPort 手动开启 EXT 5V，再按 H。

3、导入文件和操作
首次打开会自动创建 ~/amiibo_sim/。把自己的 540 字节 Amiibo .bin 备份放进这个目录，再按 T 刷新列表。支持中文文件名。
- F / X 或方向键选文件，Enter 开始模拟。
- 若要随机刷新 UID，把与备份匹配的 160 字节密钥放在同一目录。文件名可用 key_retail.bin 或 retail.bin，屏幕右上角会显示密钥状态。
- 模拟时移开手柄，按 R 换 UID，按 O 恢复原始 UID。
- Esc 停止模拟，再按一次退出。
安装包不包含 Amiibo 备份或密钥，需自行导入。

4、更新
- 0.18 存在bug，不可使用
- 0.19 已支持在 ~/amiibo_sim/ 中添加文件夹
- 0.21 支持通过web进行模拟控制及.bin文件添加

交流QQ群号：423629503

apps.title: Beamhound
apps.summary: Sniffs out your IR remote from one button press and becomes it.
apps.description:
Point a remote at the Cardputer and press Power.
Beamhound decodes the signal and finds every remote in the Flipper-IRDB database with that power code.
Remotes with identical codes count as one answer, so it only asks questions that actually separate the remaining code sets. Each turn it picks the cheapest useful question: press another button on your remote, pick the device type, pick the brand, or did your device react to this test signal?
Once matched, the profile is saved and you get a remote-control screen.

apps.title: BitaxeZero
apps.summary: Bitaxe miner farm monitor for Cardputer Zero.
apps.description:
Watch a small Bitaxe farm from your pocket. The dashboard hero shows the farm-wide total hash rate, and every card on the list carries its miner's own rate with chip and VR temperatures, fan speed and power draw. Scan your network to find miners that announce themselves over mDNS, or add one by IP address when your firmware version stays quiet. No cloud service, account or analytics. BitaxeZero discovers miners on your local network and makes read-only requests to addresses you add. Use it on a trusted network.

Open any device for a read-only detail page: its pool, shares accepted and rejected, best session difficulty, uptime and firmware version. Miners that stop answering dim to an offline card that remembers how long it has been dark, next to the ones still hashing. Your devices and their last-seen times are saved on the device, so everything is back the way you left it the next time you open the app.

apps.title: Card HY2
apps.summary: 面向 CardputerZero 的 Hysteria 2 客户端，支持节点管理、SOCKS5 和本机 TUN。
apps.description:
Card HY2 是面向 CardputerZero（ARM64）的 Hysteria 2 客户端，支持在设备上添加、编辑和切换节点。配备摄像头的机型可以扫描 Hysteria 2 节点二维码，也可生成二维码分享节点。

支持 SOCKS5 和本机 TUN。SOCKS5 默认仅监听本机，可按需开启局域网共享；TUN 可代理本机 TCP 和 UDP 流量。代理以非 root 账号在后台运行，退出界面后已启动的代理会继续工作。可选开机启动，也可使用「恢复网络」停止代理并清除已应用的代理配置。

安装包包含 Hysteria 2.14.0 官方核心，可在应用内检查核心更新。支持简体中文与英语。

本应用非Hysteria官方制作，如有涉及版权问题请联系我 感谢！

Card HY2 is a Hysteria 2 client designed for CardputerZero (ARM64), allowing you to add, edit, and switch between nodes directly on the device. On models equipped with a camera, you can scan QR codes to import Hysteria 2 nodes or generate QR codes to share them.

The app supports SOCKS5 and native TUN. SOCKS5 listens only on the local host by default, with an option to enable LAN sharing if needed; the TUN mode can proxy TCP and UDP traffic for the entire device. The proxy runs in the background under a non-root account, meaning it continues to operate even after you exit the app interface. You can configure it to launch automatically at startup, or use the "Restore Network" function to stop the proxy and clear any applied network configurations.

The installation package includes the official Hysteria 2.14.0 core, and you can check for core updates directly within the app. It supports both Simplified Chinese and English.

This application is not created by the official Hysteria team. Please contact me if there is any copyright infringement—thank you!

Card Pi 是面向 CardputerZero（ARM64）的第三方 Pi 客户端，非 Pi 官方出品。它直接调用原版 Pi CLI，沿用已有的模型、登录和配置。可以在内置终端进入 Pi 原生界面，使用 /login、`/settings` 等命令。设备未安装 Pi 时，应用会打开 Pi 官方安装器。

Card Pi 针对 320×170 屏幕和实体键盘设计，支持选择项目目录、管理会话、切换模型，以及全屏浏览 Markdown 聊天记录。应用集成 Rime 中州韵输入法，支持离线中文拼音和简繁切换，界面支持简体中文和英语。

Card Pi is an independent client for the Pi coding agent on CardputerZero (ARM64). It runs the original Pi CLI directly and uses your existing Pi settings, provider logins, and sessions. The built-in terminal lets you open Pi’s native interface and run commands such as `/login` and `/settings`. If Pi is missing, Card Pi opens the official Pi installer.

Designed for the 320 × 170 display and physical keyboard, Card Pi lets you choose project folders, manage sessions, switch models, and browse Markdown chat history in full screen. It integrates the Rime input method for offline Chinese Pinyin, with both Simplified and Traditional Chinese output. The app interface is available in Simplified Chinese and English.

鸣片（Cardenza Synth）是一台便携式四轨合成器工作站，内置四种音源引擎（808 鼓机、Juno 模拟合成器、DX7 FM 合成器、采样器），支持分轨音序器、歌曲编排、混音、轨道与总线效果器，以及 SD 卡工程存储。

本版为 CardenzaSynth 上游项目的 CardputerZero 移植版：忠实还原原作的四种音源引擎、分轨音序与歌曲编排，并针对 CP0 的 320×170 屏幕与 46 键键盘重新适配界面与操作，支持USB MIDI键盘。鼓机与合成器为内置；采样器播放你自己的采样，可以通过麦克风采样，或者把 16-bit/44.1kHz 单声道 WAV 放进 ~/.local/share/cardenza/sdcard/CardenzaSynth/Samples/ 即可（配置存于 ~/.config/Cardenza/）。
键位映射图：https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jszsj/CardenzaSynth/cp0/docs/cp0-keymap-vs-original.jpg
（PS: 1区按键长按时，可直接按3区的按键而不需要按sym）

apps.title: CardFlash
apps.summary: Download Linux distros and flash them to a USB drive, no PC needed
apps.description: Pick an OS on the Cardputer, plug a USB flash drive into the USB-A port, and CardFlash downloads the image (BitTorrent first, the project's own mirrors as backup), writes it to the drive and reads it back to verify it. Sources include Fedora, Ubuntu, Debian, Arch Linux, Manjaro, Pop!_OS, Universal Blue, FydeOS, SteamOS, Armbian, the Raspberry Pi Imager list, fosstorrents and linuxtracker. Raspberry Pi and Armbian images can be set up for first boot, and it can make Windows LTSC evaluation install sticks. Press Space on a distro to pin it to the home screen. Set the side switch to Host before plugging in the drive. Made with Claude Code.

apps.summary: The first Cardputer Zero app for Meshtastic, MeshCore, and remote MeshMonitor co
apps.description:
CardMesh is the first application developed specifically for the M5Stack Cardputer Zero, bringing Meshtastic, MeshCore, and remote MeshMonitor connectivity together in a unified, keyboard-first pocket client.

It communicates directly with Meshtastic and MeshCore LoRa mesh networks through the onboard LoRa HAT, operating one protocol at a time on the shared physical radio, with seamless switching at the tap of a button. Remote MeshMonitor connectivity is provided through its REST API.

An intuitive icon-grid home screen provides quick access to all three platforms, each featuring its own channel picker and chat interface, delivering a dedicated, portable mesh communications experience.

apps.title: Remote
apps.summary: 让 CardputerZero 变成一台「开着就能远程操作」的小电脑：局域网里任何手机/电脑打开浏览器，就能实时看到它的屏幕、用键盘操控它
apps.description:
## 它解决什么问题
CardputerZero 屏幕小、键盘迷你，调试和演示都不方便。装上这个应用后，只要设备开着机，你在局域网里用手机扫个码（或电脑输个网址）就能：

- 实时看屏幕 ：设备画面以 MJPEG 推流到浏览器（12fps、2 倍放大），页面以机身线稿为底图，屏幕内容和按键高亮直接叠在「机身」上，像看真机一样。
- 远程敲键盘 ：守护进程创建 uinput 虚拟键盘并接管系统键盘设备，浏览器里敲的字（电脑物理键盘 / 手机软键盘）直接注入设备；真实机身键盘的事件同时转发，两边都能用、互不打断。
- 带外壳录屏 ：网页端一键录制，可选「带外壳」模式把按键动效一起录进去，存到设备`/tmp/cardputer-rec/` 后随时下载；设备端 ffmpeg 方案保留作后备。
## 设备端应用（启动器里的入口）
启动器里的 Remote 应用是「入口 + 配置面板」：

- 中英双语界面，显示设备 IP、端口、服务运行状态，并生成二维码，手机扫码即连。
- IP 由`hostname -I` 动态获取，不是写死的。
- 改端口 ：按数字键输入 1024–65535 之间的端口号，按 ENTER 保存——守护进程在进程内原地重绑端口，不重启服务、不杀当前应用。
- 启动做了优化：先把上一帧缓存刷到屏幕（约 0.1s 出画面），再懒加载绘图库渲染完整界面。

apps.title: Cardputer TV
apps.summary: Cardputer Zero 轻量视频播放器，支持自定义源及帧率设置；订阅兼容性仅做有限样本测试。
apps.description:
Cardputer TV 是面向 M5Stack Cardputer Zero 的原生 C++20 轻量直播与视频播放器，适配 320×170 屏幕、机身键盘、音频输出及外接 HDMI 大屏。

【核心功能】
• 自定义播放源：支持 M3U/M3U8、频道 JSON（含注释）、HTTP(S)/HLS 及部分 TVBox 明文直播列表；HLS 弱网时可自动切换低码率。
• 原生单路播放：内置屏幕直调 FFmpeg C API（libav*）与 PulseAudio（libpulse），以音频为主时钟同步画音并支持欠载保护；切台保留最后一帧并提示状态，不双路预加载。
• 音量与偏好记忆：播放中每次增减 5%（0–100%），左下角带音量进度条；退出自动恢复进入前的系统音量，升级保留源和设置。
• 播放设置：20 / 30 / 60 fps、内置屏幕 / HDMI 大屏（mpv wlshm）、内屏 H.264 硬解开关（失败自动回退软解）、中/英文实时切换。

【快速按键】
• 列表：F/X（或上下/K/J）选台（长按加速），Z/C（或左右）翻页，回车播放，Tab 源管理（N 新增 / E 编辑 / 退格删 / R 刷新），S 设置，Esc/Q 退出。
• 播放中：F/X 切台，Z/C 调音量，Esc 停止返回。

【源导入与说明】
• 可用 SFTP/ADB 将 UTF-8 格式的 sources.json 传至 ~/.config/cardputer-zero-iptv/sources.json（建议权限 600，覆盖前请先退出应用并备份），或在源管理按 N 新增本地路径并按 R 刷新。
• 仅自带 Big Buck Bunny 公开测试流，不附带私人/商业源；不支持 DRM 解密及 jar/spider 点播脚本。第三方源与复杂订阅仅做有限样本验证，兼容性与流畅度以实际环境为准。

【运行与许可】
依赖 libav* / libpulse0 / libcurl4t64 / libidn2-0 / libfreetype6 / libpng16-16t64 / libevdev2（HDMI 可选 mpv、wlr-randr）；需读取键盘与写 framebuffer 权限，安装脚本仅设为 0755。源码未声明开源协议（NOASSERTION），内置文泉驿微米黑字体遵循 Apache-2.0。

【版本 0.3.0 更新】
• 全栈重构为原生 C++20 + LVGL v9 + FFmpeg/PulseAudio 单二进制应用（运行约 39 MiB 内存）。
• 全新「深曜石橙影」界面与 256×256 微拟物桌面图标，OSD 新增音量进度条，长分组自动单行省略，长频道名跑马灯。
• 新增内屏 V4L2 硬解开关与回退、HDMI 输出、中英文实时切换、退出恢复系统音量，并修复虚拟键盘重复触发导致的选台跳跃问题。

---

Cardputer TV is a lightweight native C++20 live stream and video player for M5Stack Cardputer Zero, built for the 320×170 panel, keypad, speaker, and external HDMI output.

[Features]
• Custom Sources: Supports M3U/M3U8, JSON channel lists (with comments), HTTP(S)/HLS streams, and select plaintext TVBox live lists, with automatic lower-bitrate HLS fallback on slow networks.
• Native Single-Stream Playback: Built-in panel playback directly uses FFmpeg C API (libav*) and PulseAudio (libpulse) with an audio-master A/V clock and underrun freeze protection. Channel zapping stops the old stream first and keeps the last frame cleanly without dual-stream preloading.
• Volume & Persistence: Adjusts volume in 5% steps (0–100%) with a bottom progress OSD and automatically restores your pre-launch system volume on exit. Existing sources and preferences are preserved across upgrades.
• Settings (press S): 20 / 30 / 60 fps target, Built-in Screen / HDMI (via mpv wlshm), Hardware H.264 Decode toggle (auto-falls back to software if unavailable), and instant 中文 / English switching.

[Controls]
• List: F/X (or Up/Down/K/J) move (hold to accelerate), Z/C (or Left/Right) page, Enter/Space play, Tab Sources (N add / E edit / Bksp delete / R refresh), S Settings, Esc/Q quit.
• Playback: F/X zap channel, Z/C adjust volume, Esc stop and return.

[Sources & Notes]
• Import custom lists by copying UTF-8 sources.json to ~/.config/cardputer-zero-iptv/sources.json (chmod 600 recommended; close the app and back up first), or add local list paths in the Sources screen.
• Ships only with the public Big Buck Bunny demo stream—no private or paid playlists included. DRM streams and jar/spider VOD scripts are not supported. Third-party playlists and TVBox variants have limited sample coverage.

[Requirements & License]
Requires framebuffer/evdev permissions and PulseAudio/PipeWire-Pulse; dependencies are declared in the .deb package (optional mpv and wlr-randr for HDMI). Post-install script only sets 0755 permissions. Source code carries NOASSERTION; bundled WenQuanYi Micro Hei font is licensed under Apache-2.0 (see fonts/).

[What's New in 0.3.0]
• Rewritten from Python into native C++20 + LVGL v9 + FFmpeg C API + libpulse (~39 MiB RSS).
• New "Obsidian Amber" rounded-card UI, redesigned 256×256 icon, volume progress OSD, single-line group truncation, and marquee titles.
• Added V4L2 H.264 hardware decode option, HDMI mode, instant Chinese/English UI toggle, automatic system volume restore, and fixed duplicate input event skipping on keypad zapping.

apps.title: WebRadio
apps.summary: 发现、收藏和收听网络电台 · Browse, save, and listen to internet radio
apps.description:
简体中文
切换界面语言：主界面按 H、6，再按 4 选简体中文，或按 5 选 English。设置会自动保存。

在 Cardputer Zero 上发现、收藏和收听网络电台。首次打开显示中国大陆电台，支持按国家／地区、语言和类型筛选，以及英文台名、频率、呼号和中文全拼搜索。可搜索当前范围或全球。收藏、筛选、应用音量和界面语言会保存到设备。按 Q 续听上次成功播放的电台。
主界面显示剩余电量。按 8 或 V 调整应用和系统音量。操作音效默认开启，按 H、4 可开关，设置自动保存。

最近改动 · 1.0.13-1
- 商店和 GitHub 介绍补充中英文界面切换步骤。

1.0.12-1
- 新增导航、确认、返回操作音效。
- 帮助页按 4 开关音效，重启后保留选择。
- 代码以 MIT 协议开源，安装包附带许可证。

English
Switch interface language from the main screen. Press H, then 6, then 4 for Simplified Chinese or 5 for English. Your choice is saved automatically.

Discover, save, and listen to internet radio on Cardputer Zero. The first launch shows mainland China stations. Filter by country or region, language, and genre. Search by English station name, frequency, call sign, or full pinyin for Chinese names, within current filters or globally. Favorites, filters, app volume, and interface language are saved on the device. Press Q to resume your last successfully played station.
The main screen shows battery percentage. Press 8 or V to adjust app and system volume. Operation sounds are enabled by default. Press H, then 4 to toggle sounds. The preference is saved.

What’s new · 1.0.13-1
- Added instructions for switching interface language to the AppStore listing and GitHub.

1.0.12-1
- Added short navigation, confirmation, and back sounds.
- Press 4 on the Controls screen to toggle sounds. The preference survives restarts.
- Released the source under MIT and included the license in the package.

License / 许可证 · MIT
Source / 源码 · https://github.com/xu-c/WebRadio

电台目录来自 Radio Browser，节目由各电台提供，WebRadio 作者不对电台内容负责。请遵守 Radio Browser 使用规则和当地适用法律。收听需要联网。
Radio Browser provides the station directory. Stations supply their own programming. The WebRadio author is not responsible for station content. Follow Radio Browser’s usage rules and applicable local laws. Streaming requires internet access.

apps.title: CardRouter
apps.summary: 把CardputerZero 变成一台口袋卡片路由器：开热点、共享上网、管理设备。
apps.description:
Card Router 把你的 CardputerZero 变成一台小巧的卡片路由器。插上网线，或无线中继家里的 Wi-Fi，它就能开出热点，让手机、电脑共享上网，并提供一套完整的路由管理功能。
主要功能：
· 开机引导向导：首次使用一步步配好语言、上网方式、热点名称密码、局域网网段，几分钟即可上手。
· 状态首页：实时显示运行状态、上联地址、路由地址、上下行速率曲线和在线客户端数。
· 客户端管理：查看已连接设备，给它起备注名，一键拉黑，按需查看信号强度。
· 路由设置：名称、密码、网段、DHCP 范围、上行方式，点哪项直接改哪项，无需重走向导。
· 端口转发：把外部端口映射到内网设备（TCP/UDP）。
· DNS 覆盖：自定义域名解析，把域名指向指定 IP（如内网 NAS），或屏蔽广告域名。
· 设备黑名单：从已连接设备里直接选择拉黑，不用手输 MAC。
· 静态租约：给指定设备固定 IP，同样从已连接设备选择。
· QoS 限速：选择档位限制带宽（关闭/2/5/10/20/50 Mbps）。
· WireGuard：放入配置即可一键连接 VPN。
· 无线中继：单射频以 wlan1 连接上级 Wi-Fi、热点跟随同信道；也支持有线上行。
· 开放热点：密码留空即为无密码开放网络。
· 中英文界面随时切换。
快捷键：
· 首页：F/X 上下移动，M 总菜单，T 启动/停止（需输入设备密码确认），S 路由设置，C 客户端，A 高级功能，W 配置向导，ESC 退出。
· 客户端页：R 改名，B 拉黑，S 查看信号。
· 规则页（转发/DNS/黑名单/租约）：Enter 添加，DEL 删除。
· 向导/编辑：Enter 下一步或保存，ESC 返回。
· Ctrl+L：切换中英文。
说明：无线中继与热点共用一块射频，速率约为单独使用的一半，热点信道会跟随上级路由。路由由系统服务托管，退出应用后仍继续运行；按 T 停止后设备自身仍可联网。

Card Router turns your CardputerZero into a compact card-sized router. Plug in Ethernet, or wirelessly relay your home Wi-Fi, and it opens a hotspot so phones and computers can share the connection — with a full set of router management tools.
Features:
· First-boot wizard: step-by-step setup of language, uplink, hotspot name/password, and LAN subnet.
· Live dashboard: running state, uplink/router addresses, real-time up/down rate chart, and online client count.
· Client management: see connected devices, add note names, block with one tap, view signal on demand.
· Router settings: edit name, password, subnet, DHCP range, or uplink directly — jump straight to the item you want.
· Port forwarding: map external ports to LAN devices (TCP/UDP).
· DNS overrides: custom domain-to-IP mapping (e.g. a LAN NAS) or ad-domain blocking.
· Device blocklist: pick a connected device to block — no manual MAC entry.
· Static leases: assign a fixed IP to a chosen device.
· QoS limit: pick a bandwidth tier (Off/2/5/10/20/50 Mbps).
· WireGuard: drop in a config and connect with one tap.
· Wireless repeater: a single radio joins the upstream Wi-Fi via wlan1 with the hotspot on the same channel; wired uplink also supported.
· Open hotspot: leave the password blank for an open network.
· Chinese/English UI switching.
Shortcuts:
· Home: F/X move, M menu, T start/stop (device password required), S router settings, C clients, A advanced, W wizard, ESC exit.
· Clients: R rename, B block, S signal.
· Rule pages: Enter add, DEL delete.
· Wizard/edit: Enter next/save, ESC back.
· Ctrl+L: toggle language.
Note: wireless repeater and hotspot share one radio (about half throughput); the hotspot follows the upstream channel. Routing is hosted by system services and keeps running after you exit the app; after T-stop the device itself stays online.
apps.depends: network-manager, iproute2

apps.title: cardterm
apps.summary: 更好的CLI终端模拟器，高性能和低内存占用、多窗口、后台会话、xterm/TUI 兼容、自定义主题和背景图
apps.description:
cardterm 是 M5Stack CardputerZero（320×170）上的全屏终端模拟器：运行 bash/ssh/codex 等任意程序，是设备上的命令行工作台。

比 APPLaunch 的 CLI 更强性能、更低内存和更多功能。对于依赖 CLI 和终端会话的用户，请尝试 cardterm 终端模拟器，而不是 APPLaunch 的 CLI。
Stronger performance, lower memory and more features than the stock APPLaunch CLI. If your work depends on the CLI and terminal sessions, try the cardterm terminal emulator instead of the APPLaunch CLI.

功能亮点：
· 极高性能和极低内存占用：稳态约 6MB，12 窗口多开会话可控，直驱 /dev/fb0，秒启动，字符渲染更快速；
· 自定义终端主题颜色和 PNG/JPG 背景图；
· TUI 兼容性：codex / opencode / crush / vim / htop / nano 等 TUI 实测渲染与交互正常，备用屏、滚动域、重绘节拍良好；
· 复杂协议支持：kitty 键盘协议 (KKP)、DA1/DA2/DECXCPR/DSR/DECRQM、DECSCUSR、DECSTR/RIS、OSC 4/10/11/12/52/110-112；
· USB/蓝牙外接键盘接管：板载 + 最多 4 个外接并行、标准 US 键位、热插拔；
· 多窗口（Ctrl+Alt+F1~F12）、回滚/翻页、三档终端大小（80×24 / 53×17 / 40×12）、toast 事件通知；
· 支持将会话和程序挂载至后台运行，退出 cardterm 后可恢复。
· 单 config.ini 配置文件，可用于配置主题配色方案、初始命令和工作目录、回滚行数、窗口数、启动横幅文本等多个配置项。

apps.description:
Colibri 是面向 Cardputer Zero 的口袋 AI 助手。

支持中文整句拼音、英文输入和本机离线中英语音转写，识别结果可编辑后发送。支持 OpenAI 兼容模型服务、图片理解和搜索 API，以及标准 MCP 和本地技能。

存储占用说明：安装包及安装后的存储占用主要来自随包提供的离线语音识别模型，用于在掌机本地完成语音转写，不依赖在线语音服务。

apps.title: Controller
apps.summary: Pair a Bluetooth game controller and see sticks, triggers and buttons live
apps.description:
Controller pairs a Bluetooth game controller with your CardputerZero and shows its input live.

Pad view: both sticks with their position and recent path, trigger pull in percent, bumpers, d-pad and every button, plus report rate and battery level. Press R to test rumble.

Data view: each axis as a normalised and a raw value, every button, and the controller's ID, address and input node.

Devices view: scan, pair, connect, disconnect and forget controllers, and reset Bluetooth if a connection gets stuck.

The controller stays connected after you close the app, so other programs can use it. The bundled /usr/share/controller/gamepad.py gives Python scripts sticks, triggers and named buttons with no extra dependencies.

Tested with an Xbox One S controller over Bluetooth LE. Written to also handle Xbox Series, PlayStation, Switch Pro, 8BitDo and other HID controllers, which have not been tried yet. Screenshots show the app's demo mode.

Keys: 1-3 or TAB switch views, ENTER selects, S scans, ESC quits.

apps.title: Universal IR
apps.summary: Universal IR remote for TV, AC and more, using the Mi Home code database
apps.description:
Turns the CardputerZero into a universal infrared remote, following the same pairing flow as the Mi Home app: pick a device type, pick a brand, fire the power key of a code set until the appliance reacts, and control it.

- Framebuffer native: draws straight to /dev/fb0, no browser or compositor, about 6% CPU when idle.
- Brand search by pinyin initials: type xm for Xiaomi or md for Midea instead of scrolling 1800+ brands; hot brands for the current device type are pinned on top.
- Stateful AC control: power, temperature, mode and fan speed go out as one complete state frame, the way Mi Home does it.
- Trial then keep: the last working remote is cached and restored on the next launch, so a configured remote keeps working offline.
- Keyboard first: the eight cells map to the eight letter keys on the device, and F/X/Z/C double as arrow keys.

The code data comes from Xiaomi's own IR database and is cached on disk. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.

apps.title: Battery Saver
apps.summary: Longer battery life: USB autosuspend, screen-off idle, low-battery shutdown
apps.description:
Battery Saver cuts the CardputerZero's battery drain by about a quarter with the screen on and about 40% with it off, so the 1750 mAh cell lasts roughly 5.6 h instead of 4.2 h on screen, and 7.5 h instead of 4.4 h off screen.

**Always on**
- Lets the internal USB Ethernet chip autosuspend. The kernel keeps it awake, which keeps the whole USB bus busy at ~8000 interrupts/s (~105 mA). USB devices and Ethernet cables still work when plugged in.
- Optional: silence the launcher's key sounds so the sound card can sleep (~35 mA).

**While the screen is off**
- Parks the launcher's audio stream so the sound card sleeps (~40 mA).
- Pauses the launcher, which keeps redrawing the LCD with the backlight off (~30 mA).
- Any key wakes everything up instantly.

**Low battery**
- Shuts down cleanly at 8% (5–20% or never).

WiFi, SSH and Tailscale keep working. Each measure can be switched off in the app, which also shows the live battery current. The service runs as the desktop user, not root.

Keys: F/X move, Z/C or Enter change, I info, Esc back.

apps.title: Desk Mode
apps.summary: Plug in HDMI, get the Pi desktop, type on the Cardputer's own keyboard
apps.description:
Desk Mode turns the CardputerZero into a small desktop computer: plug in an HDMI display and the Raspberry Pi desktop starts on it, while the built-in screen and the launcher keep working.

**HDMI desktop**
- Starts automatically when HDMI is plugged in (can be switched off), or from the app.
- Runs as your user, without LightDM and without root. LightDM's login screen starts a second audio server that takes the sound card from the launcher and can freeze it; Desk Mode avoids that.
- Nothing runs while HDMI is unplugged. Close the desktop from the app (frees ~55 MB of RAM), or let Battery Saver close it 1 min after HDMI is unplugged (its default).

**Built-in keyboard on the HDMI display**
- Each time HDMI is plugged in, the built-in screen lights up and asks whether the keyboard should go to the HDMI display (or set it to always / never).
- Symbols typed with Sym come out right on the desktop (the keyboard sends non-standard codes for them; Desk Mode translates).
- Ctrl+Alt+Esc gives the keyboard back to the Cardputer. Unplugging HDMI or closing the desktop does too, and the built-in screen wakes up.
- While the keyboard is on the HDMI display, the built-in screen turns off to save power.

Keys: F/X move, Enter change, I info, Esc back.

apps.title: Peers
apps.summary: Peers for Tailscale (unofficial): QR login, device list, one-key SSH, copy IPs
apps.description:
Peers is an unofficial Tailscale companion for the CardputerZero, like the device list of the desktop app.

**Log in with your phone**
- Not logged in yet? Press Enter: a QR code appears on the screen. Scan it with your phone and log in there; the Cardputer joins your tailnet by itself. The link is shown too, to open on any other device.
- Log out from the This Cardputer page (m, then o).
- Tailscale not installed? Press Enter to install it with the official script (needs sudo and internet).

**Devices**
- Every device on your tailnet: online first, with its Tailscale IP and how you reach it (direct, DERP relay, or when it was last seen). The exit node in use is marked EXIT.
- Type / to filter by name, IP or OS.

**Per device** (Enter)
- SSH: asks for the user and port once per device, then runs ssh right in the launcher's built-in terminal; when the session ends you are back in the list.
- Copy the IPv4, IPv6 or DNS name. There is no system clipboard, so the copy is kept for the cz-peers-clip command: ssh pi@$(cz-peers-clip) in the CLI app.
- Shell here: bash with $IP and $HOST set to that device.
- tailscale ping (shows direct or DERP and the latency), details (owner, OS, traffic, key expiry, tags), use as exit node.

**SSH keys**
- K makes an SSH key if there is none and shows the public key as a QR code to scan with your phone.
- k on a device logs in once with its password and adds the key to its authorized_keys (Linux, macOS and Windows), so ssh needs no password after that.
- When ssh is refused, the app explains why and offers the next step: add the key, show it, or forget a changed host key. Devices that run Tailscale SSH are marked with a blue S.

**This Cardputer** (m)
- IPs, MagicDNS name, account, key expiry (warns 14 days ahead), health warnings.
- Connect / disconnect (t), choose an exit node and LAN access (e), log out (o).

Runs inside the launcher's terminal and talks to tailscaled directly; nothing runs in the background. Installing lets the desktop user change Tailscale settings (tailscale set --operator); if Tailscale is installed later, the app offers to do that when a change is refused.

Keys: F/X move, C (or Enter) actions, Z back, s ssh, k add key, K show key, y copy, p ping, i details, m this device, l log in, ? help, Esc quits.

Unofficial app, not affiliated with or endorsed by Tailscale Inc. Tailscale is a registered trademark of Tailscale Inc.

apps.title: TV
apps.summary: Live TV from any M3U playlist, on the card or on a TV.
apps.description: A tiny, fast TV guide. Point it at any M3U playlist - your Jellyfin or Plex, your IPTV provider, an iptv-org list, or a file of URLs you wrote yourself - browse it by group or type any letter to search, press ENTER and it plays. On the Cardputer Zero's own 320x170 screen, or fullscreen on a TV the moment an HDMI cable is plugged in, and it follows the cable live. Hardware-decoded by the card's VideoCore, so the CPU barely moves, and it picks the smallest rendition for the little screen and the biggest for the TV. Ships with 27 free live channels built in - news, world, sport and classic TV, straight from the broadcasters' own CDNs - so it works the moment you install it, with no account and no config file. Adding more needs no terminal: Add channels is a row on the home screen, and it lists the packs the app ships with and any playlist already on the card - a USB stick, a file you copied over - so a channel is usually two keypresses. An address can be typed in as well, and the app checks a stream actually plays before it writes it down. Channels add up rather than replace. A static Rust binary, two crates, instant start, under 600 kB resident while playing.

apps.title: CZ cam
apps.summary: 14种胶片滤镜的小相机
apps.description:
把 CardputerZero 的 8MP 相机变成一台"能看见参数"的相机。

【为什么做这个】
CardputerZero 的曝光全在 libcamera 里：自动曝光会自己挑快门和增益，你按了快门却不知道刚才那张是 1/30 还是 1/4 秒、ISO 是 100 还是 1600。CZ 相机把这三件事变成屏幕上的常驻读数，并且让 EV 真正生效。

【界面】
左侧 216×162 取景（4:3，与静态照片同构图），右侧 104px 仪表栏固定不动，一眼扫完：ISO（等效 100 × 模拟增益，吸附到 400 / 800 等标准档）、快门（1/4000 … 1s，显示成 1/125、0.5S）、EV 数值 + ±3 档刻度条、亮度直方图（过曝堆在右端）、电量与实测帧率。读数来自每一帧的 libcamera 元数据，显示的就是传感器此刻真的在做什么。

【怎么用】
◀ ▶  自动模式 1/3 档曝光补偿；手动模式切快门
▲ ▼  自动模式 ±1 档；手动模式切 ISO
M     自动 / 手动切换（手动时以当前测光值为基准，EV 显示偏离多少档）
A     锁定曝光 AE-L，可再偏移快门，适合先测光再构图
B     一键黑白（压 ISP 饱和度，取景和 JPEG 一起变灰）
Q     画幅 2MP ↔ 8MP
O     画面方向：0° / 镜像 / 180° / 翻转，选好自动记住
G     三分构图线    L  中/英界面    H  帮助    ESC  退出

【拍照】
ENTER 拍 JPEG 到 ~/Pictures/CZCam/，旁边写一个同名 .json 记录这张的 ISO / 快门 / 增益 / 照度。默认 2MP（1640×1232，IMX219 原生 4:3/30fps 模式），按下到写完通常几百毫秒；按 Q 可切 8MP。保存有三级回退：配置画幅 → 较小画幅 → 取景流，失败原因会显示在屏幕上并写入 ~/.cache/czcam/czcam.log。

【适合谁】
· 想拿 CardputerZero 当随身测光表 / 取景器的人
· 想学曝光三要素、需要看得见 ISO 和快门的人
· 想要一台"按下就有 2MP 照片 + 曝光记录"的口袋机的人

【说明】
原生 Linux 程序，直接写 framebuffer，走 libcamera / picamera2，不依赖 X、不依赖任何 pip 包。需要系统里的 python3-picamera2 与 python3-numpy（镜像通常已自带）。固定焦距，无自动对焦、无录像、无闪光灯。

apps.description:
Adds a 2.8" ILI9341 SPI display (240x320) to the EXT header and mirrors the built-in screen on it. Manage the external display's settings from the app. Full screen CLI also included.

- 1:1 mirror with a status bar (clock, battery, IP, RAM, CPU) in the spare rows, or stretch to fill
- BigTermCLI: a full-size terminal on the EXT display, with the same keys and colors as the CLI app and saved command history
- Brightness follows the built-in screen, or set it from 10 to 100%

apps.summary: 🔥 DOOM Zero: pocket-sized Hell, custom controls & a bloody secret! 😈
apps.description:
# 🔥 WELCOME TO HELL. IT FITS IN YOUR POCKET! 😈💀

## 320 × 170 PIXELS OF ABSOLUTE DISRESPECT! 🩸🔥

**DOOM Zero** turns your **Cardputer Zero** into a tiny doorway to pixelated Hell! 🎮🔥 One gritty, blood-red launcher. Multiple classic DOOM entries. A suspicious UAC terminal. And a demon with absolutely zero customer-service training. 😂👹

### 🎮 ONE LAUNCHER. MANY WAYS TO FIND TROUBLE.
Browse classic DOOM entries and supported WAD-based adventures from a single hellish menu. **DOOM (1993)** gets past the *name-check* without a riddle — because legends don't queue. 😎 You still need the game files you're entitled to use.

### 🔐 A SECRET ONLY A TRUE MARINE SHOULD KNOW...
The other protected doors are guarded by a UAC security question. Your mission: **know your Marine's name**. Here's a hint: *even the old DOOM novels have something to say about him*. 🤫📖

Get it wrong? **HELL REJECTED YOU!** 💥🩸 A flying fireball, a screen full of animated blood, and an unforgettable personal review from Hell's least-qualified receptionist:

**“WRONG NAME, ROOKIE! EVEN AN IMP KNOWS THAT!”** 🤣💀

No spoilers. Study the lore, Marine. 🔥

### ⌨️ YOUR KEYS. YOUR RULES.
The mandatory **UAC MARINE TRAINING** guides first-time players through assigning their own movement, turning, firing and door-use keys, one step at a time. Save your choices and adjust them later in **Settings > Controls**. Your keyboard, your battlefield! 🫡🎯

### 🩸 TINY SCREEN. BIG DOOM ENERGY.
Dark industrial metal, infernal pixels, KG branding and a lovingly overdramatic rejection animation — all designed for the real **320×170 Cardputer Zero** display. 🦾🔥

### 📂 FEED THE PORTAL — BRING YOUR OWN WADS! 😈🔥

**Hell is open. The keyboard is ready. Unfortunately, the Imp at reception ate the setup instructions.** 👹📋

UAC has investigated the incident and promoted him to Head of Documentation.

So, Marine — here is where your game files go.

**DOOM Zero does not include commercial DOOM WAD files.** Bring compatible game data you are legally entitled to use. UAC calls this the **Bring Your Own Apocalypse** programme. 💀🎒

#### 1. Give your WADs a home 🏠🔥

On your **Cardputer Zero**, use this folder:

```text
~/.local/share/doom-zero-dev0/wads/
```

**Folder missing?** Open a terminal on the Cardputer, or connect through SSH, and run:

```sh
mkdir -p ~/.local/share/doom-zero-dev0/wads/
```

Use the **same user account that launches DOOM Zero**.

The `~` means that user’s home directory **on the Cardputer**. Creating this folder on your laptop will not open a portal on the other device. UAC’s interdimensional file transfer department remains disappointingly understaffed. 🖥️🌀

This is the default location. If you have deliberately configured `XDG_DATA_HOME`, the WAD folder is inside that location under `doom-zero-dev0/wads/`.

#### 2. Deliver the goods 📦💀

Copy your actual `.wad` files into that folder using SFTP/SCP or a file manager.

Examples:

- **`doom1.wad`** — DOOM shareware: a small introductory serving of Hell.
- **`doom.wad`** — registered DOOM / The Ultimate DOOM: the classic bad day at work.
- **`doom2.wad`** — DOOM II: Hell has discovered your home address.
- **`tnt.wad`** — TNT: Evilution: workplace safety has left the building.
- **`plutonia.wad`** — The Plutonia Experiment: UAC accepts no responsibility for your vocabulary.

**Extract ZIP archives first.** The launcher needs the `.wad` files inside them. Even our receptionist cannot run a game by threatening a ZIP file. 📦👹

**Can't see `.local`?** It is a hidden folder. Enable **Show hidden files** in your file manager. Hidden directory. Very ordinary explanation. We checked for demons. Mostly. 👀

#### 3. Tell the launcher the shipment has arrived 🔄🔥

Return to **DOOM Zero’s main menu** and press **R** to rescan.

A game becomes available when its required data and compatible engine are detected.

Still seeing **MISSING GAME DATA**? Check that the correct `.wad` file is inside the folder on the Cardputer and has been extracted from its archive.

**Finding the WAD folder should not be a secret level. We already have other ways to test your Marine credentials.** 🤫🔐

**RIP AND TEAR — AFTER THE FILE TRANSFER!** 😈🔥🎮

### ⚠️ BEFORE YOU ENTER THE PORTAL
- **DOOM Zero is a launcher, not a bundle of commercial DOOM games.** Commercial WAD/game files are **not included**; provide game data you are legally entitled to use. 📂
- Game entries require compatible engines and the appropriate data files. The launcher reports missing data.
- Classic Chocolate Doom **does not support jumping**. 🚫🦘
- **DOOM 64 is not supported** in this version.

apps.title: DualRadio
apps.summary: Built-in + USB Wi-Fi/Bluetooth manager: monitor survey, hotspot, BT pairing
apps.description:
Manage the CardputerZero's built-in radio and a USB Wi-Fi/Bluetooth dongle side by side.

Wi-Fi
- Connect, disconnect or forget networks on each radio separately, or disconnect both at once. Saved passwords work on both radios.
- Scan with a 2.4/5 GHz filter and full network details: channel, width, 802.11 standard, WPA2/WPA3/PMF, clients, channel load, router model and every access point with its maker.
- Choose the main network other apps use; the built-in radio takes over when the dongle drops.
- Duplicate guard: the dongle never joins the same network and band as the built-in radio.
- Monitor-mode survey on 2.4 and 5 GHz: access points, clients, channel lock and pcap recording for Wireshark. Realtek RTL8821CU/RTL8811CU dongles are reset automatically so 2.4 GHz monitor mode works every time.
- Hidden networks: names revealed when a device joins, otherwise labelled with their router or maker.
- Hotspot from the built-in radio, plus ping and download speed test per radio.

Bluetooth (built-in and dongle separately)
- Classic + BLE scan with live signal; device class, services, manufacturer, iBeacon/Apple/Microsoft adverts and distance estimate.
- Pair (passkey or PIN on screen), connect, trust, remove, and a signal "hunt" view to find a device.

Three themes (Slate, Neon, Daylight) and a Large text size. Arrows without Fn: F/X/Z/C. Esc = back, hold Esc = exit.
Tested with the TP-Link Archer T2UB Nano and BrosTrend AC650. Source and full key map: github.com/RIAL0/DualRadio

apps.title: Dweebs™ Pets
apps.summary: Hatch it. Hug it. Love it.
apps.description:
Dweebs Pets is a virtual pet with a big fuzzy heart.

Pick one of three eggs, watch it wobble and crack, and name the little Dweeb that pops out. From then on it's yours to look after: feed it, wash it, tuck it into bed, and give it all the hugs and tickles it can take. Every Dweeb has its own fur, face and personality - some are cheeky, some are shy, all of them are loveable.

Take your Dweeb out to the garden, the park, the beach, the forest, the snow, the rooftop - even the Moon. Play six games together, float around in bubbles, try on hats and glasses, and throw a party with balloons and birthday cake.

Friends drop in to visit. Dweebs fall in love, lay an egg, and raise a brand-new baby Dweeb that nobody has ever seen before - and when it grows up it heads off to make its own life, sending postcards home. Every happy moment goes into a photo album to look back on when your Dweeb is old and wise. And every December, Christmas comes to Dweeb town, with decorations, presents and carols.

Got a LoRa cap? Your Dweeb can meet other Dweebs nearby with no internet needed: wave hello, send gifts, invite friends to parties and go visiting. CardputerZeros on the same Wi-Fi find each other too, and everything else works with no radio at all. Plug in HDMI and your Dweeb moves onto the big screen.

Made to be kind and safe for children: gentle life lessons, nothing scary, and a friendly-words filter on every name and message.

Features

* Hatch your own Dweeb from an egg and give it a name.
* 10 breeds, each with its own fur, colours, face and personality.
* Feed, wash, play, sleep, hugs and tickles - and it remembers who loves it.
* 10 places to explore: from the bedroom and garden to the beach, snow and the Moon.
* 6 games: Snack Catch, Find the Dweeb, Copy Me, Bubble Pop, Dweeb Dash, Dance Off.
* Bubbles to float in and pop, hats, glasses and outfits.
* Visitors, birthdays and parties with balloons and cake.
* Dweebs fall in love and raise never-before-seen babies who grow up and leave home.
* A photo album of happy memories for when your Dweeb grows old.
* Christmas celebrations every December.
* Meet other Dweebs nearby over LoRa (with a LoRa cap) or local Wi-Fi.
* HDMI support for the big screen.
* Original music, jingles and the real Dweeb voices.
* Kind and safe for kids: no scary content, friendly-words filter.

apps.description:
EDGECAM 把 CardputerZero 变成一台掌上 DV 取景相机。全屏 320×170 HUD 显示 REC/时间码、电量、实时曝光和变焦条，按 I 可以一键隐藏全部界面，只留干净画面。

NORMAL 是冷色调（蓝青高光、冷阴影），KARAX 是暖调胶片（颗粒、暗角、成片泛光）。1.0–3.0× 数码变焦带缓动，按住 9/0 可以连续变焦；拍照为 1640×1232，按下快门的瞬间定格当前画面，没有进度条；R 录制带滤镜的 320×170 H.264 视频。

EDGECAM turns the CardputerZero into a tiny DV viewfinder camera. A full-screen 320×170 HUD shows REC/timecode, battery, live exposure and a zoom bar; press I to hide the whole overlay and keep a clean frame.

NORMAL is a cool blue-teal grade, KARAX is a warm film look with grain, vignette and halation in stills. Digital zoom ranges from 1.0× to 3.0× with smooth easing — hold 9/0 to keep zooming. Snapshots are 1640×1232 and freeze the exact frame at the moment you press the shutter, with no progress bar. R records the filtered viewfinder to a 320×170 H.264 clip.

Built around the fixed-focus IMX219 (~1 m), fully offline: no accounts, no network, no telemetry; photos and clips stay on the device.

apps.title: ESP32-C5 Spectrum

apps.description:
Your Wi-Fi scanner tells you which networks are around. It doesn't tell you about the microwave in the kitchen, the video sender in the corner, or the cheap camera hammering channel 6. This does.

Plug an ESP32-C5 board (LilyGO T-Dongle-C5, Seeed XIAO ESP32-C5, or Waveshare ESP32-C5) running esp32c5-spectrum into the CardputerZero's side USB port to see all the radio energy across 2.4 and 5 GHz — with a live trace, peak hold, scrolling waterfall, spectral density view, Chanalyzer-style Wi-Fi channel masks, and a channel busy scorecard that names your quietest channel. Includes a built-in Demo Mode (press D) so you can explore the views without hardware attached.

Made by JJ (James Julier). Radio backend powered by ESP-SDR by Florian Euchner (ESPARGOS), licensed under GPL-3.0.

apps.title: Ethernet Tester
apps.summary: Read-only Ethernet diagnostics, gateway checks and local device discovery.
apps.description: Ethernet Tester provides read-only diagnostics for eth0: link state, speed and duplex, available interface counters, IPv4/MAC/gateway and DNS configuration, driver metadata, and current systemd-networkd DHCP lease details where supported. It can send one ping to the configured gateway and show a snapshot of cumulative interface counters; this is not a throughput test. On explicit user action, it can scan the local IPv4 subnet with arp-scan, browse mDNS/DNS-SD services, or make one PTR lookup for the gateway. Separate passive views listen for LLDP/CDP switch announcements and ARP, DHCP and STP frames; no packet capture is saved. The package grants cap_net_raw to the executable for passive listening. The app does not configure the interface, renew DHCP, or request CAP_NET_ADMIN.

A full-bleed viewfinder with a see-through side panel, or a slim pure-framing mode. Press W to start a token-protected Wi-Fi gallery and scan the QR code: photos open in any phone browser. Photos are saved with the film look baked in, plus halation and grain. Film copies render on the GPU (EGL/GLES2) in about 1.6 s for a full 8 MP frame. apps.description:
简体中文
在 Cardputer Zero 上下五子棋。可与 Rapfi 对弈，选择三档难度，也可在同一台设备轮流落子。联机时，Zero 和浏览器都可创建房间，用 6 位房间码加入。同一局域网内可双 Zero、双网页或混合对战，电脑无需安装或运行额外程序。支持 15×15 和 13×13 棋盘、自由规则与连珠禁手，界面提供简体中文和英文。联机配对需要互联网连接，对局在局域网内直连。网页版：https://fivezero.vercel.app/ 连珠禁手可按需显示禁手点，并选择禁止落子或直接判负。

Zero 切换语言：从主菜单进入「设置 / Settings」，选中「语言 / Language」，按 Enter 或左右方向键（Z / C）切换简体中文和 English。网页版可用右上角的「English / 简体中文」按钮切换。

最近改动（1.2.1-4）
补充 Zero 和网页版的语言切换步骤。

English
Play Gomoku against Rapfi at three difficulty levels, take turns on one Cardputer Zero, or play over your LAN. Either a Zero or a browser can host or join using a 6-digit room code. The browser needs no extra software. Choose a 15×15 or 13×13 board with Freestyle or Renju fouls. The interface supports Simplified Chinese and English. Pairing requires internet access. Moves travel directly between players on the LAN. Web app: https://fivezero.vercel.app/ Renju offers forbidden-point markers and a choice of blocking foul moves or counting them as a loss.

To change the language on Zero, open Settings (设置) from the main menu, select Language (语言), and press Enter or Left/Right (Z/C) to switch between Simplified Chinese and English. On the web, use the English / 简体中文 button in the top right.

What’s new (1.2.1-4)
Added instructions for changing the language on Zero and on the web.

许可 / Licenses
Five 采用 GPL-3.0-or-later。Rapfi 引擎采用 GPL-3.0-or-later，模型权重采用 CC0-1.0，安装包附有对应的 Rapfi 源码与构建脚本。
Five and the bundled Rapfi engine are licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later. Rapfi model weights use CC0-1.0. The package includes Rapfi’s corresponding source and build script.

apps.title: flightZero
apps.summary: 专为 CardputerZero 打造的轻量级实时航空雷达与全球空域监视应用，支持本地雷达、全球全景下钻、航司识别与中英双语切换。
apps.description:
**FlightZero** 是一款运行于 CardputerZero（`arm64` / `320×170` 屏幕）的实时 ADS-B 航班监视工具，集成本地机场雷达、全球空域全景与航班详情查询，全键盘即可流畅操作。

#### 核心功能
- **本地雷达视图（Local Radar）**
  - 以选定机场或实时 GNSS / 北斗定位（`GPS`）为中心扫描周边空域，实时绘制航班航向机徽、运动尾迹、邻近机场及水系/海岸线底图。
  - 底部状态栏实时显示选中航班的呼号、机型、高度、地速、距离与升降趋势。
- **全球空域全景（Global Map）**
  - 一屏俯瞰全球实时航班分布（`x1`），支持保形多级缩放（如 `x4` 聚焦东亚及中国空域）与山脉/盆地/海域地形标注。
  - 移动光标并按 `Enter` 可直接下钻至对应位置的局部雷达视图。
- **航班列表与航司识别**
  - 列表视图按距离由近及远排序，方便快速定位最近航班。
  - 按 `Enter` 打开详情弹窗，自动识别常见 ICAO 呼号前缀并显示航司名称，同时展示机型、注册号、应答机编码、高度、地速、升降率、航向、距离、方位及经纬度。
- **81 座机场数据库与坐标参考**
  - 内置覆盖国内省会枢纽及全球主要机场的 81 座机场基准点，按 `C` 键支持输入首字母/简码实时筛选，并支持切换至实时 GNSS 卫星定位。
  - 按 `K` 键查看当前机场雷达详情，同步提供 **WGS84** 航空坐标与 **火星坐标系 GCJ-02（高德参考）**，以及标高、主跑道方向和邻近机场距离。
- **双语界面与灵活设置**
  - 支持简体中文 / English 一键即时切换（`L` 键），支持公制（`km / m`）与航空单位切换（`U` 键）。
  - 系统设置中可自定义局部雷达半径、局部刷新周期、全球缓存周期与网络接口加速模式，修改后自动保存。

#### 常用快捷键
- `Tab` / `1-3`：切换本地雷达 / 全球地图 / 航班列表
- `方向键` / `W A S D`：平移地图 / 移动光标或列表行
- `I` / `O`（或 `+` / `-`）：缩放雷达半径或全球地图倍率
- `N` / `P`（或 `.` / `,`）：切换上 / 下一架飞机
- `Enter`：查看航班详情 / 全球视图下钻
- `C` / `K`：切换基准机场或定位 / 查看机场坐标与跑道详情
- `F` / `G`：回到机场中心 / 切换 GNSS 定位
- `U` / `L` / `R`：切换单位 / 切换中英文 / 立即强制刷新
- `M` / `H`（`?`）：打开系统设置 / 查看按键说明

**Short Description:**
Real-time local flight radar and global ADS-B airspace tracker for CardputerZero, featuring 81 airport beacons, airline lookup, GNSS support, and instant EN/CN switching.

**Features:**
- **Local Radar & Global Map:** Track nearby aircraft with heading sprites, trails, and coastlines, or zoom (`x1`–`x4`) across the global airspace and press `Enter` to drill down.
- **Flight List & Detail:** Distance-sorted traffic list and detailed aircraft card with ICAO airline prefix lookup, squawk, altitude, groundspeed, vertical rate, bearing, and coordinates.
- **81 Airports & Dual Coordinates:** Fast prefix search (`C`) plus instant GNSS mode, and airport info modal (`K`) showing both WGS84 and GCJ-02 reference coordinates, elevation, and primary runway headings.
- **Full Keyboard Control & Bilingual UI:** Instant English/Chinese toggle (`L`), Metric/Aviation unit switch (`U`), and configurable refresh intervals (`M`).

apps.title: Frotz Zero
apps.summary: Play Z-machine adventures with saves, readable text and an online library.
apps.description: A graphical Frotz frontend for v3-v8 Z-machine adventures on Cardputer Zero. No playable stories or game media are bundled with the installer. The original CC0 test/demo stories are supplied as rebuildable source and can be installed separately. Use the built-in Downloads menu to get stories from Andrew Plotkin's Infocom catalogue (https://eblong.com/infocom/) and the IF Archive Z-code collection (https://www.ifarchive.org/indexes/if-archive/games/zcode/), including supported ZIP bundles, or copy your own story files to the device. Home shows Continue with the last played title, Library, Downloads, Settings, Help and Exit. Story pages offer covers, summaries, play/save actions and confirmed deletion that keeps saved games and shared media. All four arrows and visible number shortcuts navigate menus. Ctrl+V offers Reader, Fit Screen, Fill Screen, Fit Width, Actual Pixels, Reading Zoom, Frame + Text Zoom and Automatic. Ctrl+U/D changes size; Ctrl+P/N recalls commands. Reader includes untimed opening title pauses and keeps your place during resizing. Automatic is the default for every supported V3-V8 story. It wraps text at the chosen size, including timed prompts; Tab shows the original artwork, maps and status without advancing the game. Existing stories switch once, and later manual choices persist. Continue retains the readable page and text/original-view selection. Framed zoom fills the screen with a V6 border while enlarging its main text window at untimed command prompts; original wide lines may need panning. Catalogue notes are cached offline; manual links have QR codes. Includes named-save Load, Rename and confirmed Delete with automatic Continue protected, Quetzal saves, history, scrollback, mute/volume, dark/light themes, offline credits and Continue at supported untimed v3-v5/v7/v8 prompts. V6 automatic resume is unavailable; use story SAVE/RESTORE. No commercial stories or covers are included. Screenshots use the original CC0 demonstration stories.

apps.description:
Gemini Live turns the Cardputer Zero into a real-time conversational voice assistant powered by the Google Gemini Live API (BidiGenerateContent).

Speak naturally into the built-in microphone and hear spoken replies through the speaker while both sides of the conversation stream live on the 320x170 screen — user prompts anchored on the right and assistant replies on the left, each with an inline voice waveform indicator. Press ESC or key 6 while the assistant is speaking to interrupt the reply and immediately start listening again, or press key 5 to clear the history and start a fresh conversation context.

In Settings, configure your Google AI Studio API key (with a built-in QR code link and Ctrl+V clipboard paste), pick from live-capable Gemini models (including extended-thinking models), select a prebuilt voice (Kore, Puck, Charon, Fenrir, Aoede, Leda, Orus, Vesta, Zephyr), and customize the system instructions using the full-screen English/Ukrainian (EN/UA) keyboard editor with Sym, Shift, Fn, Ctrl, Alt layer highlights and Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V clipboard support.

Herdr Zero 是专为 CardputerZero 打造的 Herdr 客户端。

主要能力：
- Space 视图与 Agent 视图：与桌面端 Herdr 共享 Machine -> Space -> Pane 三列布局，按 Tab 可切换到跨机器的 Agent 视图（支持按最新动态、状态或名称排序及按机器筛选）。
- Agent 会话视图：在 Codex、Claude Code 或 pi 的 Agent 上按 Enter，按时间顺序浏览对话消息，查看当前动作，直接通过卡片响应权限审批或 AskUserQuestion 提问；底部回复框自动保存草稿，按 Enter 确认后才发送。
- 交互终端与只读历史：通过 libghostty-vt 直接接管普通 Shell、TUI 菜单与 Vim（Ctrl+Tab 返回概览且不中断远端任务），也可按 r 以只读模式浏览历史输出而不改变远端终端尺寸。
- 掌上输入与中英双语界面：设置中可随时切换简体中文与英文界面；内置本地 Rime 简体拼音输入（Ctrl+Space），并支持 ElevenLabs 语音听写（Ctrl+R 按住或点按，转写结果作为可编辑文本插入，不会自动回车发送）。

使用前提：
- Wi-Fi 网络与 Tailscale 账号（扫码或打开链接在浏览器中授权）。
- 同一 tailnet 内开启 SSH 的开发主机（支持 Tailscale SSH、密钥、密码及交互式认证）。若远端尚未安装或需更新 Herdr Core（hc），应用会在征得你明确确认后将其安装到远端用户主目录。
- 可选：如需使用语音听写，需自备 ElevenLabs API Key（可在本机输入，也可通过同 tailnet 的本地网页暂存并在掌机上按键确认导入）。

数据与隐私说明：
- 终端文本、会话日志与回复通过 Tailscale 与 SSH 在掌机与你自己的开发主机之间传输；内置 Tailscale 节点按常规方式连接 Tailscale 协调与中继服务。
- 仅在触发语音听写（Ctrl+R）期间，麦克风音频经校验证书的 TLS 流式发送至 ElevenLabs（使用你自己的 API Key）；应用仅在内存中处理音频，不写入磁盘或日志，云端留存策略由你的 ElevenLabs 账号设置及服务条款决定。
- 本地状态（settings.json、drafts.json、presets.json、machines.json、ssh/、tailnet /）以仅属主可读写权限保存在 ~/.local/state/herdr-zero/，升级或卸载安装包后默认保留 ，如需彻底清除请手动删除该目录。应用不安装 root 或开机后台服务，退出时自动清理本地辅助进程，远端任务继续运行。

apps.title: ICOMzero
apps.summary: Direct radio listening, waterfall, CW decoding and FT8 with QSO logging.
apps.description:
Turn your Cardputer Zero into a direct network radio companion. Choose Radio, FT8, Log or Settings from the icon menu; no computer bridge is needed for the supported network radios.

RADIO — Listen through the speaker with a live spectrum/waterfall. Fn+F/Fn+X zoom the spectrum and waterfall from 1× to 8× around the tuned frequency. Hold Z/C to tune, select bands and USB/LSB/CW/CW-R modes, and save a 1000/500/100 Hz step per radio. Volume and mute are saved. Noise reduction and antenna-tuner controls are available where supported; starting the tuner briefly transmits.

CW — Receive-only Morse decoding with automatic or manual tone selection, detected pitch and estimated speed. W enables decoding without changing the radio mode, dial or filter. F/X scrolls history; hold to repeat and return to the bottom to follow new text. Up to 16,384 characters stay in memory during a Radio session. Retunes and resynchronization start a new line instead of clearing the history. Crowded signals and irregular sending can still cause errors.

FT8 — Silent reception, Messages with subdued region and signal-strength details, highlighted CQ/POTA/SOTA calls and conversations involving you, offline country/territory estimates and USA state labels. Enter replies to a selected decode or continues its current exchange. Auto audio frequency follows the other station and replies use the opposite UTC period. Standard contacts use RRR and finish with 73. Local TX rows appear after the transmit period.

AUTOMATION — Auto CQ sends one own CQ, then tries up to five fresh strong CQ stations twice each if unanswered. Callers heard during another exchange enter a queue. POTA Hunt monitors POTA/SOTA CQs, starts with a direct R-report and allows three unanswered attempts per stage before resting and monitoring again. Both modes must be started explicitly and stop on faults.

LOGBOOK — Open Log from the main menu to browse/search onboard contacts and view reports, frequency and upload status. Add a manual contact with UTC date/time, mode, frequency, grid and reports. Sync Wavelog or QRZ to download full contact records, match duplicates and queue missing local uploads. Provider credentials and station identity are also available in main Settings. Existing records are never overwritten or deleted.

LOGGING — Save completed contacts locally with ADIF data and independently upload to Wavelog and QRZ. Retry pending uploads, review a manual Record QSO entry, and import worked history with Sync Log. Hide previous contacts applies to FT8 on the current band; Auto CQ still answers or queues worked stations addressing you. Green QSO notifications and optional speaker beeps confirm local saves. QRZ API access may require a subscription.

SETTINGS — Name, edit and clone multiple radio profiles. Check GitHub updates at launch or manually, with download progress and SHA-256 verification. Credentials and private diagnostic/session journals remain on the device and are not bundled publicly.

FT8 requires configured station identity, synchronized device time and radio TX permission. Automatic antenna tuning briefly transmits after selecting a band. SWR above 2.0, excessive ALC, stale active-TX telemetry, clock/PTT failures and disconnects stop transmission. Press Enter to request warning clearance; faults do not restart TX automatically. Network-polled protection supplements the radio's protection.

Direct profiles: IC-705, IC-7300MK2, IC-7610, IC-7760, IC-7850/7851, IC-905, IC-9700, IC-R8600 (RX only), and native KNS for TS-890S. IC-7300MK2 is physically tested; other profiles await hardware validation. USB/serial-only radios and the original IC-7300 are outside this direct-network release.

apps.title: Jiggler
apps.summary: Keeps a connected computer awake by simulating mouse or keyboard activity over U
apps.description:
Jiggler turns your CardputerZero into a tiny USB mouse/keyboard that keeps a connected computer from going idle, sleeping or locking. No software or drivers are needed on the computer. It works with Windows and macOS.                                                                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 How to use                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
  1. Set the USB switch to Device.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  2. Plug the right-side USB-C port into the computer (it charges the Cardputer at the same time).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  3. Open Jiggler and press 4 to start.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

Controls (the five keys under the screen)
  4  Start / stop
  5  Mode: Mouse → Keyboard → Mouse + Keyboard
  6 / 7  Shorter / longer interval
  8  Info
  ESC (hold)  Exit

Details
  - Mouse mode nudges the pointer a few pixels and moves it straight back, so it never drifts away.
  - Keyboard mode only taps Shift, so nothing is ever typed.
  - Moves happen at random times inside a window you set (default 5–15 s) instead of a fixed beat.
  - While jiggling, the screen turns off after 30 s to save battery and heat. Any key wakes it without triggering an action.
  - Your mode and interval are remembered between sessions.
  - Light and dark themes.

Installs a small boot-time service (jiggler-hid-gadget) that sets up the USB keyboard/mouse. It runs without root and does nothing else.

KanSTL opens STL 3D models on the Cardputer Zero and lets you look at them from every side.
Pick a file from the built-in browser, then rotate and zoom with the keypad. One key cycles four looks: solid, edges, metallic and wireframe, and auto-rotate turns the model slowly when you want to see it all round. A small XYZ gizmo keeps you oriented.

Models are read straight from the device: copy STL files over SSH or a USB stick, and the browser remembers the folder you were in. Binary and ASCII files both work.

No permissions, no network, no background service.Open source, GPL-3.0.

apps.title: Kesha Code LLM
apps.summary: On-device LLM that writes & runs scripts, with chat and camera recognition
apps.description:
Kesha Code LLM runs small language models entirely on the M5Stack Cardputer Zero with llama.cpp — no account, no cloud.

Code: each project has a file manager, a tiny sh/Python editor and a console. A local model writes, names and edits scripts for you from the project chat, using built-in skills for common tasks (wifi, web server, Python snippets, battery and more). Pick the model per task: a 90M for speed, a 350M for better code, or a 0.5B coder to leave thinking.

Power mode frees RAM so the bigger models fit (it lowers gpu_mem and turns the camera off; reversible, needs a restart).

Chat: talk to a small model offline.
Vision: live object detection (YOLOX) with boxes and percentages, text recognition (OCR), photos and annotated video.
Models: download, switch and delete models, or drop in your own .gguf / .onnx files.

Always review a script before you run it.

apps.title: LAN Proxy
apps.summary: Connect Cardputer Zero to a LAN HTTP or SOCKS5 proxy
apps.description:
LAN Proxy connects your Cardputer Zero to an existing HTTP or SOCKS5 proxy on your local network. Enter the address and port once, then press Enter to connect or disconnect. Optional proxy authentication is supported.
The connection stays active when you return to the launcher. A green badge on the app icon shows that the background service is running. Devices on the local network remain directly accessible.
Requires a reachable LAN proxy. Both modes carry IPv4 TCP and DNS. Public IPv6 and general UDP forwarding are unavailable. 

LAN Proxy 可让 Cardputer Zero 使用局域网已有的 HTTP 或 SOCKS5 代理。填写一次地址、端口和可选账号密码，之后按 Enter 即可连接或断开。
返回启动器后，代理继续在后台运行，图标右上角以绿色角标显示运行状态。访问局域网设备仍走直连。
使用前需准备同一局域网内可访问的代理服务。两种模式均转发 IPv4 TCP 和 DNS，公网 IPv6 和普通 UDP 暂不支持。

Plug into any switch port and the home screen shows link speed and flaps, your DHCP lease and the switch's name, port, VLAN, voice VLAN, PoE class/wattage and management IP from LLDP/CDP, with alerts for speed/duplex mismatch and 802.1X ports that want a login. Tabs: DHCP probe that flags rogue servers; trunk VLAN discovery with one-key join (DHCP on the VLAN, then every tool runs there); ping with a live latency graph; a NET check (DNS on this port's servers, internet or captive portal, traceroute); ARP sweep with MAC vendors; a TCP port grid; and a CSV log of every port you plug into, with notes. Ctrl+S saves a screenshot. DHCP probe, NET check, ARP sweep and port scan send traffic; use them only on networks you are authorized to test.

- Library browsing and search: add multiple local music folders, index your collection, browse by artist, album, song, genre, composer or compilation, and search and sort the library.

- Playback and queue: pause, resume, skip, seek, adjust volume, shuffle, repeat one or repeat all. Use the playback queue and built-in smart playlists for recently added, most played and recently played music.
- Covers and lyrics: see album artwork and track information in Now Playing. The lyrics page supports plain lyrics and synchronized highlighting, using embedded content or online matches.
- Equalizer and presets: adjust frequency gains with a 10-band equalizer and switch presets.
- Network sources: configure media servers such as Jellyfin, Emby and OpenSubsonic/Navidrome, or play network audio URLs and internet radio. Supply a reachable service address and any required account permissions.
- Device controls and visualization: contextual icon actions map to keys 4-8. Now Playing uses a translucent background spectrum, and the three white keyboard LEDs follow its rightmost column.
- Stop-and-exit and screen timers: the close timer stops playback and exits LoFiBox without powering off the device. An independent idle-screen timer turns off the backlight while music continues; the first wake key only wakes the display. Both timers reset to OFF when the app is reopened.
- Multiple control interfaces: the device GUI, terminal TUI, command-line CLI and browser WebUI share playback state. Control the player remotely from a browser on the local network.

Online scraping results depend on the network and available data sources. This release provides built-in smart playlists and does not include custom playlist editing.

zh-CN.title: LoFiBox
zh-CN.summary: 集音乐库、信息刮削、歌词、均衡器和网络音源于一体的掌上音乐播放器。
zh-CN.description:
LoFiBox 是一款为 Cardputer Zero 打造的音乐播放器，将本地音乐库、联网刮削、网络音源和多种控制界面集中在掌上设备中。

- 音乐库浏览与搜索：添加多个本地音乐目录，建立音乐索引，按歌手、专辑、歌曲、流派、作曲者和合辑浏览，支持搜索与排序。
- 音乐信息刮削：读取音乐文件中的标签，联网匹配并补全歌曲信息、专辑封面和歌词，在本地缓存匹配结果。在文件格式与写入权限支持、结果符合写入规则时，可将元数据、封面或歌词回写到本地音乐文件。
- 播放与队列：支持暂停、继续、上一首、下一首、进度跳转、音量调整、随机播放、单曲循环和列表循环；提供播放队列，以及最近添加、最多播放、最近播放等内置智能歌单。
- 封面与歌词：播放页显示专辑封面和曲目信息，歌词页支持普通歌词与随播放进度高亮的同步歌词，可使用文件内嵌内容或在线匹配结果。
- 均衡器与预设：提供 10 段均衡器和预设切换，可按喜好调整各频段增益。
- 网络音源：可配置 Jellyfin、Emby、OpenSubsonic/Navidrome 等媒体服务器，也可播放网络音频地址与网络电台；需自行提供可访问的服务地址及必要的账号权限。
- 设备交互与音乐可视化：各页面提供与数字键 4–8 对应的图标操作；Now Playing 使用半透明背景频谱，三颗白色键盘灯跟随最右侧频谱柱变化。
- 定时关闭与息屏：定时关闭会停止播放并退出 LoFiBox，不关闭设备电源；独立的定时息屏在音乐继续播放时关闭背光，首次唤醒按键只负责唤醒。两个计时设置在重新打开应用后均恢复为关闭。

ja.title: LoFiBox
ja.summary: ライブラリ、情報取得、歌詞、EQ、ネットワーク音源を備えた携帯音楽プレーヤー
ja.description:
LoFiBox は Cardputer Zero 向けの音楽プレーヤーです。ローカルライブラリ、オンラインでの音楽情報取得、ネットワーク音源、複数の操作画面を携帯端末にまとめています。

- ライブラリの参照と検索：複数のローカル音楽フォルダーを追加してインデックスを作成し、アーティスト、アルバム、曲、ジャンル、作曲者、コンピレーション別に参照できます。検索と並べ替えにも対応します。
- 音楽情報の取得：埋め込みタグを読み取り、曲情報、アルバム画像、歌詞をオンラインで照合・補完し、結果をローカルにキャッシュします。形式、書き込み権限、書き戻し規則が許可する場合、メタデータ、画像、歌詞をローカル音楽ファイルへ書き戻せます。
- 再生とキュー：一時停止、再開、曲送り、シーク、音量調整、シャッフル、1 曲リピート、全曲リピートに対応します。再生キューと、最近追加・よく再生・最近再生の内蔵スマートプレイリストを利用できます。
- 画像と歌詞：再生画面にアルバム画像と曲情報を表示します。歌詞画面は通常の歌詞と再生位置に合わせたハイライトに対応し、埋め込みデータまたはオンラインの照合結果を使用します。
- イコライザーとプリセット：10 バンドの周波数ゲインを調整し、プリセットを切り替えられます。
- ネットワーク音源：Jellyfin、Emby、OpenSubsonic/Navidrome などのメディアサーバーを設定でき、音声 URL やインターネットラジオも再生できます。アクセス可能なサービスアドレスと必要なアカウント権限を用意してください。
- 端末操作と可視化：各画面のアイコン操作は数字キー 4–8 に対応します。再生画面には半透明の背景スペクトラムを表示し、3 個の白いキーボード LED が右端のスペクトラムに追従します。
- 終了と消灯のタイマー：終了タイマーは再生を停止して LoFiBox を終了し、端末の電源は切りません。独立したアイドル消灯タイマーは音楽の再生中もバックライトを消灯します。最初のキー入力は画面の復帰のみを行います。どちらのタイマーもアプリを開き直すと OFF に戻ります。
- 複数の操作方法：端末 GUI、端末画面 TUI、コマンドライン CLI、ブラウザー WebUI が再生状態を共有します。ローカルネットワーク上のブラウザーからリモート操作できます。

オンラインで取得できる情報は、ネットワークとデータ提供元によって異なります。この版は内蔵スマートプレイリストを提供し、カスタムプレイリスト編集は含みません。

apps.title: LokiCTL
apps.summary: Network multitool: live status, hotspot, VPN, device finder and network checks
apps.description:
LokiCTL shows what your network is doing and gives you the usual tools to look into it. It works with the CardputerZero's built-in Wi-Fi and Ethernet port.

Modes: turn the Cardputer into a small router, run a hotspot next to your Wi-Fi, or send its traffic through a WireGuard VPN. With a hotspot and the VPN together it becomes a VPN gateway with a kill switch, and a leak test checks that nothing goes around the tunnel. You can see which devices are on the hotspot, what names they look up, and block one.

Tools: ping, DNS lookup, traceroute, a Wi-Fi scan, a port scan, and speed tests to the internet and to other devices on your own network (iperf3). The port scan says what runs on each open port and points out known security holes and old versions. A sign-in helper deals with hotel and cafe Wi-Fi that wants you to log in on a web page.

Your network: Discover finds the devices on it, and the map shows how it is built, down to the switch port you are plugged into and the route to the internet. The health check looks for common weak spots in one go. Watch listens quietly and tells you about new devices, a fake router, a second DHCP server or a port scan against the Cardputer. The trap (a honeypot) shows who pokes at fake services. Reports put what LokiCTL found into one page you can open on a PC.

With an optional USB Wi-Fi stick, a Wi-Fi survey listens for kick-off attacks, look-alike networks and busy channels.

On a phone or computer: switch on Remote view and open the dashboard in a browser on the same network. It shows the same things on a bigger screen, with plain explanations and steps to fix what it finds, and you can switch modes, run the tools, add a VPN file and see the Cardputer's screen from there. Laptop link lets a laptop plug straight into the Cardputer's cable port.

Three looks (Instrument, Constellation and Terminal), and a command bar if you would rather type. Only scan and probe networks you own or are allowed to test.

apps.title: LokiCZ
apps.summary: Pocket security toolkit: capture, wardrive, audit, radar, mesh — Loki levels up
apps.description: LokiCZ turns a Cardputer Zero and its radio caps into a pocket security lab. With a supported USB Wi-Fi dongle it captures WPA handshakes (passive, deauth-free), wardrives to WiGLE-format CSV, and runs a Bjorn-style network audit — host discovery, port and service scans, CVE correlation with NVD links — from the device or its built-in LAN web portal; the CC1101 cap sweeps 433/915 MHz, records raw OOK remote signals to Flipper .sub files, and probes the cap's ST25R3916 NFC frontend; a passive sniffer flags drone Remote ID and known surveillance-device fingerprints over Wi-Fi and BLE; the sniffer also decodes OpenDroneID Wi-Fi broadcasts (drone + operator positions); a nightly watchdog diffs audits and flags new hosts, ports and CVEs; the LoRa cap runs Meshtastic or MeshCore under one supervisor — one radio, one owner — and records GPS tracks; radar screens plot live air traffic (ADS-B) and nearby BLE devices; a tracker watch listens for AirTag/SmartTag/Tile followers and a probe logger maps the network names nearby devices ask for. Everything feeds the Loki avatar: captures, audits, wardrives and sniffs earn XP, levels unlock titles (Mortal to All-Father's Problem) and gear — horns, armor, capes, gems, a scepter — worn by the character on the home screen and in the portal wardrobe. Built for your own lab gear and networks you are authorized to test. USB WI-FI DONGLES (Debian 13 / kernel 6.12, in-kernel drivers): recommended — ALFA AWUS036ACM (MT7612U, dual-band, full monitor + injection). Also plug-and-play: ALFA AWUS036ACHM, Panda PAU0B, ASUS USB-AC51 (MT7610U); ALFA AWUS036NHA (AR9271, 2.4 GHz); Panda PAU09 (RT5572) and PAU06 (RT5372); RTL8822BU adapters (capture works, injection limited). RTL8812AU/8811AU adapters (e.g. Archer T2U Nano) also work on the lokicz image — its Raspberry Pi 6.18 kernel carries their in-kernel driver, though a stock Debian 13 install is too old for them. Full supported-dongle list: docs/DONGLES.md in the source repo. Community, build logs and support: the Loki Discord — https://discord.gg/xm54g9UsvF. Disclaimer: LokiCZ is an educational security-research tool intended for your own devices, your own lab, and networks and systems you own or are explicitly authorized to test. Unauthorized interception or testing of other people's systems may be illegal; the responsibility for lawful use rests with the operator.

apps.title: Lookout
apps.summary: Portable security camera or inspection camera, view on any browser in network.
apps.description:
Turn the Cardputer Zero into a portable security camera or an inspection camera for hard-to-see places. Open Lookout, scan the QR code with your phone, and your phone's browser shows the live camera - no app, no account, nothing leaves your Wi-Fi network.

- Live video in any phone or computer browser (480p, 720p or 1080p)
- Listen through the microphone with adjustable boost (+12/+24/+36 dB); the mic only runs while someone is listening
- Snapshots, rotate and full-screen on the phone; change quality from the phone
- Live preview on the Cardputer for aiming, plus a full-screen view
- Sleep mode turns the screen off; the camera only runs while someone is watching
- The Cardputer always shows when someone is watching or listening
- Private link: the QR code carries a secret key, and N makes a new one (and disconnects everyone)

Keys: Enter big QR, V full-screen view, Q quality, M mic on/off, G mic boost, R rotate 180, S sleep, N new link, hold Esc to exit.

apps.title: LORA Tunnel
apps.summary: All-in-one LoRa + Wi-Fi/BLE wardriver: full mesh decode, WiGLE logs, Recon
apps.description: LORA Tunnel turns the CardputerZero and Cap LoRa-1262 into an all-in-one LoRa, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth wardriver. One press starts all three. It listens for Meshtastic and MeshCore on every preset in your region and decrypts the default channels and any keys you add. It decodes text, positions, node info, all telemetry, traceroutes with per-hop SNR, neighbor lists, map reports, waypoints, MeshCore adverts, group messages, traces and discovery, and maps every node it hears. Every Wi-Fi network and BLE device is logged with GPS into a WiGLE-ready CSV. Recon flags ALPR and Flock cameras, body cameras, Ring and other cameras, trackers like AirTag and SmartTag, Remote ID drones and more, warns you, and tells you if something seems to follow you. Messages lets you chat on Meshtastic and MeshCore channels. Transmit is off until you turn it on, and it keeps to your region's limits. Logs are LoRaTAP PCAP (Wireshark), JSONL and SQLite, with CSV and Google Earth KML export. Same channel plan as Kismet's LoRaPipe. MIT open source.

apps.title: M-Pocket
apps.summary: A Mastodon client for Cardputer Zero.
apps.description:
M-Pocket brings Mastodon to the M5Stack Cardputer Zero. Browse your home timeline and interact with posts in an interface designed for the Cardputer’s compact 320 × 170 screen and keyboard.

Choose a Mastodon server and sign in by scanning a QR code with your phone or by entering an access token. Save your login on the device to return to your account without signing in again.

Read and scroll through posts, like them, boost them, or write replies. Content warnings keep sensitive posts hidden until you choose to reveal them. Search for posts on servers that support Mastodon search. Choose a light or dark theme and adjust the text size in settings.

M-Pocket is open source and available through the Cardputer app store. It requires a network connection and a Mastodon account.

apps.title: MatrixZero
apps.summary: Encrypted Matrix chat: rooms, DMs, photos, voice messages, emoji verify
apps.description:
MatrixZero is a full Matrix client for the Cardputer Zero. Sign in to matrix.org or your own homeserver and chat straight from the keyboard.

What it can do:
- Rooms, direct messages and invites, with unread counts, pinning and search
- End-to-end encryption, the same as Element and FluffyChat
- Verify this device from your phone by comparing emoji
- Unlock older encrypted messages with your recovery key
- Reply, edit, delete and react
- Take a photo with the camera and send it, and view images full screen
- Record and send voice messages, and play audio in the chat
- File names on photos, audio and documents
- Emoji in names and messages
- Rooms and messages are saved, so it opens fast

Keys: 4 Menu, 5 React (Pin on the room list), 6 Reply (Find on the room list), 7 Help, 8 Settings. f z x c move around. Fn+H shows every key. Hold Esc to quit.

Your session and keys stay on the device in ~/.local/share/matrixzero.

apps.title: MeshCore
apps.summary: Standalone mesh messaging on your Cardputer Zero. No companion needed.
apps.description: Channels and direct messages in one simple inbox, with previews, unread counts and saved history. Offline GPS-centred radar map with node distances, bearings and optional GPS location sharing. Cached online MeshCore preset catalog with Hungary and offline fallback; optional experimental SoCal/upper-900 MHz selection with confirmation. Editable region-wide scope and 1/2/3-byte path hashes. Channel options for muting, scope overrides, clearing history and leaving; password-encrypted full backup and restore. Join Public, hashtag or encrypted private channels with a shared key, import/export firmware-compatible private keys, discover nodes, and select regional radio presets including Scotland / ScotMesh (sco scope, 3-byte paths), Slovakia and experimental Japan. Uses the attached SX1262 LoRa CAP directly. One flood advert after startup checks, instant Tab navigation, authenticated repeater status with optional locally saved passwords, offline color emoji, radio echo indicators, optional message chimes, and display sleep following system DarkTime. Checks for GitHub updates at startup and offers Update or Later, with staged download progress and timing logs. Early access; supports legacy and current SX1262 CAPs; regional field testing pending outside the US.

apps.title: Mouse Jiggler
apps.summary: Bluetooth mouse that nudges the pointer to keep a host awake
apps.description:
Turns the CardputerZero into a real Bluetooth HID mouse and nudges the host pointer in one of three rhythms: Slow (2 px every 30 s), Fast (5 px every 10 s) and Jiggle (20-30 px every 100 ms).

Pair once from the device itself, then start or stop the movement from the carousel UI. Stop always releases every button, so the pointer never sticks. The device name can be edited on the device keyboard, and the chosen mode is remembered across restarts.

Alternating movement vectors keep the pointer around its starting point instead of dragging it across the screen. No dongle, no cable, no host-side software: Windows, macOS and Linux see an ordinary Bluetooth mouse.

Saved pairing is retained while Muse service connections retry.


Muser 是独立开发的非官方社区应用，支持语音、字幕、英文键盘聊天和本次会话记录。

英语默认、简体中文可切换；无需 Fn 即可使用消息翻页、按键帮助等导航。

App 内扫码在手机粘贴个人 SDK token 后自动蓝牙配对，与 Meta 无隶属或背书关系。

Muse 并非在所有地区可用，请在配对前确认你处于支持的地区且账号可用。

apps.title: MusicTagger
apps.summary: 扫描音乐目录，在线匹配封面与歌词，并写回音乐文件标签
apps.description:
MusicTagger 是给 CardputerZero 用的歌词与封面匹配工具，让只有音频的音乐文件也能补全专辑封面和歌词标签。

主要功能：
• 扫描音乐目录：默认扫描 ~/Music，支持 MP3、FLAC、M4A/MP4；列出曲目并标记是否已有封面和歌词。
• 在线匹配：优先 QQ 音乐，失败时自动回退 iTunes；匹配到的封面和歌词直接写回音频文件标签，不需要电脑。
• 封面预览：右侧实时显示当前歌曲的专辑封面，没有封面时显示占位图。
• 歌词预览：按 L 打开内嵌歌词，F/X 逐行滚动，Z/C 翻页，ESC 或 L 返回。
• 匹配操作：Enter 匹配当前歌曲；A 匹配全部；Ctrl+A 全选后再按 Enter 一键匹配所有歌曲。
• 状态标识：COVER / LYRICS 两列圆点分别表示封面和歌词是否已有，绿点=有，白色空心=没有；当前歌曲行会放大显示并用青绿色边框标出。
• 主题切换：T 键切换浅色/青蓝深色主题，选择会自动记住。

使用说明：
• 需要联网访问匹配服务；首次匹配会在后台启动 Python 助手，任务结束后自动退出，不常驻后台。
• 已完整的歌曲会自动跳过，不会重复写入；修改标签前建议先备份音乐文件。
• 支持读取内嵌歌词（ID3 USLT / Vorbis LYRICS / MP4 ©lyr）并在设备上滚动预览。

注意事项：
• QQ 音乐接口为非官方接口，仅供个人使用；接口不可用时会自动回退 iTunes。
• 封面和歌词版权归原权利人所有，请仅用于个人合法拥有的音乐。

apps.title: NetTest
apps.summary: Network tester: link status, switch & port via LLDP/CDP, ping and DNS checks
apps.description: NetTest turns the CardputerZero into a pocket network tester. The Ethernet page shows link state, speed and duplex, IPv4/IPv6 address, gateway, DNS and MAC, plus the switch name, port, VLAN and management IP the switch advertises over LLDP or CDP, so you can find out where a wall jack goes. The Wi-Fi page shows SSID, signal strength and addresses. The Tests page pings the gateway and 1.1.1.1, queries every configured DNS server directly, and checks internet access over TCP 443, with a one-line verdict. Use the 4/5/6 keys for the Ethernet, Wi-Fi and Tests pages, Up/Down to switch interfaces, 7 to re-run the checks and 8 for light/dark mode. Vibecoded with Claude Code.

apps.title: NET Toolkit
apps.summary: NET Toolkit是给CardputerZero用的随身网络工具箱，把现场排障常用的命令做成一块小屏就能操作的界面。
apps.description:
主要功能：
• 接口配置：查看链路/IP/MAC/网关/DNS，支持 DHCP 或静态地址
• Ping：逐包延迟、丢包率、min/avg/max/mdev 与抖动统计
• 端口扫描：TCP 端口列表扫描，开放端口绿色高亮
• 路由追踪：逐跳路径与每跳延迟，可设置最大跳数
• 局域网扫描：发现同网段设备的 IP/MAC/厂家，并识别 Web 管理页
• DNS / ARP：A/AAAA 与反向解析、IP→MAC 与厂家识别
• SSH / Telnet / 串口：交互式终端，共享 39×10 字符屏幕
• 子网计算器：IP 与掩码分开输入，输出网络/掩码/通配符/广播/可用范围/主机数
• Wi-Fi 信号：实时信号强度与曲线、周边 AP 表格（信道/信号/dBm/加密）、信道占用图，选中项可上下翻页
• Wi-Fi 连接：选中 AP 输入密码即可连接；系统里保存过的网络只需设备密码，并可按 P 查看已保存密码
• 热点：开启 WPA2 热点；接有线回程时可共享上网，面板会显示上行状态
• 网速测试：10 秒 HTTP 下载测速，显示平均 Mbps、耗时与 TTFB
• 文件投送：局域网 HTTP 投递，一次性 PIN
• 历史与设置：结果可保存、逐条删除；中英文、主题、Ping 次数、追踪跳数均可调整
快捷键：
• 全局：Ctrl+S 保存结果，Ctrl+L 中英文，Ctrl+T 主题，Ctrl+I 设置，Ctrl+C 停止任务
• 菜单：F 上移，X 下移，Z 向左翻页，C 向右翻页，Enter 打开，Esc 退出
• Wi-Fi：Enter 连接选中 AP，C 切换信道图，R 重新扫描，P 查看已保存密码
• 历史：Enter 查看记录，DEL 删除；记录详情页按 Esc 返回历史列表
• SSH 表单：Ctrl+S 保存书签，Ctrl+B 读取书签，Ctrl+K 清除 SSH 指纹
说明：修改网络设置、连接 Wi-Fi 和开关热点需要输入设备密码，仅在用户主动操作时提权执行；应用不安装 sudoers 文件，也不包含常驻后台服务。
Features:
- Interfaces: link, IPv4, MAC, gateway, DNS; DHCP or static addressing
- Ping: per-reply latency, loss, min/avg/max/mdev and jitter
- Port scan: TCP port lists with open ports highlighted
- Traceroute: hop-by-hop path and latency, configurable max hops
- LAN scan: discover neighbours with IP/MAC/vendor and spot web admin pages
- DNS / ARP: A/AAAA and reverse lookups, IP to MAC with OUI vendor
- SSH / Telnet / Serial: interactive consoles on a shared 39x10 terminal
- Subnet calculator: separate IP and mask fields; network, wildcard,
  broadcast, usable range and host count
- Wi-Fi: live RSSI and sparkline, nearby AP table (channel, signal, dBm,
  encryption), channel-load chart, paged selection
- Wi-Fi connect: tap an AP and enter its password; saved networks only ask
  for the device password, and P reveals the saved password
- Hotspot: WPA2 access point; shares a wired uplink and shows its state
- Speed test: 10 second HTTP download with average Mbps, elapsed and TTFB
- File drop: local HTTP upload page with a one-time PIN
- History and settings: save results, delete entries, language, theme,
  ping count and traceroute hops
Shortcuts:
- Global: Ctrl+S save, Ctrl+L language, Ctrl+T theme, Ctrl+I settings,
  Ctrl+C stop a running task
- Menu: F up, X down, Z page left, C page right, Enter open, Esc exit
- Wi-Fi: Enter connect the selected AP, C toggle channel chart, R rescan,
  P reveal the saved password
- History: Enter open a record, DEL delete, Esc returns to the list
- SSH form: Ctrl+S save bookmark, Ctrl+B load bookmark, Ctrl+K clear host keys
Network changes, Wi-Fi joins and hotspot switching ask for the device
password and run only on user action; the package installs no sudoers file
and no background service.

apps.description:
基于原作者@creativedash作品进行迁移开发，并针对CP0特性优化各项功能。(https://x.com/creativedash/status/2122000830895386680)
驾驶战机在程序化生成的岛屿、海洋与云层上空作战，支持俯视视角和尾随视角。按住 J 键使用机炮，将敌机保持在瞄准框内完成锁定，按 K 发射制导导弹。三名敌方王牌会巡航、转向攻击你、扫射并发射导弹；敌机逼近时威胁环会收缩。危急时刻按 R 键翻滚规避导弹：导弹擦身而过时时间会变慢，此时发射导弹可以打出三连反击。命中目标会迸出火花、冒出浓烟并伴随屏幕震动；被击落的敌机拖着火焰坠入海中。战机损毁时，你会乘坐弹射火箭升空：看着座舱盖炸开，在最后一刻脱离，然后登上前来接应的救援战机，全程配有无线电语音。内置扬声器可以播放合成的引擎、机炮和爆炸音效。仅键盘操作：方向键 或 Z/C/F/X 控制飞行，Enter 加速，J 机炮，K 导弹，R 翻滚，Tab 切换视角，Esc 退出。
Ported from the original work by @creativedash, all features optimized for CardputerZero (CP0).
(https://x.com/creativedash/status/2122000830895386680)
Fly a fighter over procedural islands, sea and clouds in top-down or chase view. Hold J for the cannon, hold an enemy in the sights to lock, K to loose a guided missile. Three enemy aces wander, turn on you, fire bursts and launch missiles of their own; the threat rings close as one comes in. Roll with R at the last moment to throw a missile off: time slows as it goes by, and a missile fired in that moment becomes a three-shot counter-attack.. Hits spark, smoke and shake the screen; shot-down foes fall burning into the sea. Lose your jet and you go out through the sky on the seat rocket: watch the canopy bloom, cut loose at the last moment and drop into the cockpit of the jet coming to pick you up, radio chatter and all. Synthesized engine, gun and explosion audio through the built-in speaker. Keyboard only: arrows or Z/C/F/X to fly, Enter boost, J gun, K missile, R roll, Tab view, Esc quit.
