apps.description: LoRa Scanner shows and decodes what is on the air in the US 902-928 MHz band using the Cap LoRa-1262. Spectrum with max-hold and a waterfall show activity across the band. The Meshtastic Finder listens on each preset's default frequency and decodes the public default channel: text messages, node names, telemetry, positions and traceroutes (private channels stay encrypted). The LoRaWAN page hops the US915 channels of any sub-band (or the gateway downlink channels) and decodes frame headers: device address, network (The Things Network, Helium...), frame counter, port, and join requests with the device's EUI. Every packet is listed with full details and a hex dump, logged to ~/LoRaScan/packets.csv, and - with the Cap's GPS - plotted on a coverage map you can export as a Google Earth KML file. Receive only: it never transmits. Requires the Cap LoRa-1262.

The Sky page shows every tracked satellite above the horizon right now.

Groups: space stations (ISS, Tiangong), the brightest satellites, amateur radio satellites and weather satellites. apps.title: Quartermaster
apps.summary: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, aircraft and LoRa mesh wardriver: WiGLE logs, auto uploads
apps.description: Quartermaster turns the CardputerZero into a wardriver for every supported radio you plug in. Every supported USB Wi-Fi adapter scans at once across 2.4, 5 and 6 GHz, next to the built-in radio and Bluetooth, and it still wardrives with no adapter at all. Add ESP32-C5 boards as Quartermaster Nodes, on USB or wireless through one hub node, and the channels are shared out between them. Flash a node from the Cardputer itself. With an RTL-SDR stick it logs the aircraft around you, and with the Cap LoRa-1262 it logs the Meshtastic and MeshCore nodes it hears. It only listens. GPS comes from a USB receiver, the Cap LoRa-1262, a Grove GPS unit or gpsd, found by itself. Each device is counted once, with only its closest and its furthest sighting. Logs are WigleWifi-1.6 CSV files, and finished logs go by themselves to WiGLE, WDGWars and Wardrift whenever the Cardputer is online. Aircraft and mesh nodes go to WDGWars and Wardrift only. Add your keys by scanning a QR code with your phone or by typing them, and test each one from the device. While you wardrive, Drive Alerts can warn you with a banner and a tone of your choice about Flock cameras, body cameras, camera glasses and the other kinds you pick, from what the scan already hears and without slowing it, and a Dragon Detector on USB adds its own detections. Recon is a separate mode that watches for ALPR and Flock cameras, body cameras, doorbell and security cameras, camera glasses, trackers such as AirTag and SmartTag, Remote ID drones and more, warns you, tells you if a device seems to follow you, and has a signal finder. Deep scan, off by default, lets a spare USB adapter listen in monitor mode during a wardrive or Recon: it only listens, adds every network it hears to the log, and finds Flock cameras from their probes, disconnect floods and evil twins. Large live counters, a log browser with the upload state of every site, a hardware screen for every radio, and Check for updates. GPL-3.0 open source.

RFID 1.0.4 for CardputerZero: READ, SAVED, EMU and TOOLS for M5 NFC CAP (SPI), M5 NFC Unit (IIC), PN532, PN532Killer and compatible UHF readers. Includes saved MFC dump writing, MFKey32v2/MFKey64/Staticnested tools and JSON-backed NTAG emulation. Hardware support varies by function; an external reader is required.

1.0.4 improves GroveNFC emulation and RFID read streaming, verifies PN532Killer ISO15693 block writes by readback, and adjusts NFC Unit listener recovery and MFKey UID input.

SPI MFC 1K encrypted emulation remains experimental and disabled by default because restart authentication regression is unresolved. Its kernel helper is not installed by this package. The intermittent panel-mode trigger remains under investigation; panel-mode recovery remains enabled.

apps.title: RTL SDR
apps.summary: Listen to FM, airband, shortwave and ham radio with an RTL-SDR dongle.
apps.description:
RTL SDR turns your Cardputer Zero into a pocket radio receiver. 

You'll need an RTL-SDR USB dongle (plugged into the USB port) and an antenna, as the Cardputer can't pick up radio on its own. 

Tune broadcast FM, medium wave and shortwave AM, airband and military airband, marine and ham bands from 160m up to 23cm, and anything else from 0.1 MHz to 1.7 GHz. 

Pick a band, mode (FMW, FMN, AM, USB, LSB, CW), filter width and step, or type an exact frequency. 

There's a live spectrum and waterfall, an SNR meter, squelch, an auto notch filter, and RIT. 

Press H any time for a key guide.

Tested on RTL-SDR Blog V3 and Nooelec NESDR SMArt v5

While chasing it shows distance, bearing and elevation to the balloon on a compass, its track on an OpenStreetMap map, a Skew-T log-P diagram of the sounding, and the landing point predicted from the wind profile measured during ascent. The RS41 decoders are included; a GPS receiver (gpsd) is needed for distance, bearing and the beeper.

apps.title: Sparrow
apps.summary: An illuminated almanac of the real sky, your chart and your time.
apps.description:
Sparrow is a book of illuminated pages for the CardputerZero, drawn live as vector art in the manner of a medieval manuscript.

The pages:
- The Flight: a flight along the roads of a country where America and Britain meet, in the light of the hour (dawn, day, dusk, night).
- Moon & Stars: the real sky over your horizon, with the Moon in its true phase, 1,600 stars, the planets and the Sun.
- Zodiac Chart: the sky now as a Western chart, or as a Vedic one with your current periods.
- Date of Birth: enter it once in a candle-lit book; the pages below read it.
- Life Orrery: where you stand in a life of eighty years, by life, decade and year.
- Time Garden: the week as a morning glory, sown on Monday and in flower on Sunday.
- Biorhythm: your rhythms as an alchemist's stone and flask.
- Love: ten kinds of love as circles that draw your own mark.
- Polarity: Sun and Moon qualities in five pairs on an alchemist's balance.
- Tree of Life: an apple tree in the season of the date, the garden's life about it, and seven stations in glyph and verse.
- Triptych: past, present and future from your date of birth, in three panels of your numbers.
- I Ching: the day's figure from the Book of Changes, cast by the yarrow stalks from your date of birth.
- Seal of the Day: your number for the day as a sign to learn, a solid in its colour inside its halo.
- Tarot: the seventy-eight cards of the Waite-Smith deck, to turn through and to take apart.
- Pentagram Ritual: the Lesser Banishing Ritual of the Pentagram, to learn its words, to be guided through it as you turn with the device in your hand, and to recall.
- Resonance, Tuner and Vesica: what is vibrating around you, as a figure of sand, as a named tone, and as two waves that meet, from the microphone and the motion sensor.
- Body Chord, Attunement, Wild Pendulum and Stillness: biofeedback pages that find your breath, heartbeat and tremor, sound them as a chord, and lead the breath down with tones.

Navigation is the same everywhere, and it follows the signs printed on the keyboard: the arrow keys (Z, X, C and F, no FN needed) steer every page and OK acts, N opens the contents, H opens the help screen for the page in view, a page's own key opens it from anywhere, and DEL or ESC goes back. A steps the sound through silence, a quiet background score on the solfeggio tones and an offline narrator that reads the pages; S and D make it quieter and louder.

Sparrow opens with a hand. Choose five numbers, one on each fingertip, and they lock your profile: your date of birth and your choices are sealed in an encrypted file on the device and open only with those numbers. If you forget them there is no way back in, only a fresh start.

Everything is computed on the device. Sound from the microphone is analysed in memory and never stored. Sparrow needs no network and no account. Set your latitude and longitude in sparrow.conf for a true horizon.

Sparrow is an almanac and a biofeedback tool, not a medical device. It does not give medical advice, diagnose, treat or prevent any condition, or make health suggestions. For anything about your health, ask a qualified professional.

apps.description:
Square SDR turns your Cardputer Zero into a pocket controller for a Square SDR 2 (or other Hermes-Lite 2 style) radio. 

You'll need the radio, connected to the Cardputer by Ethernet, as this app doesn't pick up signals on its own.

Listen from 0 to 30 MHz in USB, LSB, AM or CW, with a live spectrum and waterfall, an S meter, an auto notch to zap whistles, and RIT to nudge the receive pitch. 

Hold Tab to transmit (built-in or USB mic) or tap to send CW when CW Mode is selected.

Press H any time for a key guide.

You need a valid amateur radio licence to transmit! 

Transmit is kept to UK amateur bands, cuts out after 3 minutes or if you retune, and backs off on high SWR. 

Please test on a dummy load first.

apps.description:
I ported the Lua drone simulator StickTime to Rust for the CardputerZero which runs surprisingly well! I figured I should share the experience if anyone else is wanting to practice their flying with their CardputerZero. 
Mainly built around using a BetaFPV Air75 II & Meteor75 Pro II with Lava II 580mAh/680mAh batteries and a RadioMaster Pocket or EdgeTX radio controller over USB/Bluetooth. It has some realism built in like prop wash, battery sag, etc. that is all customizable to some degree. 
I also added sounds, an analog video filter, HDMI support and graphics settings.
Feel free to let me know if any issues, do a pull request or fork it on GitHub unless I might have already updated it!

apps.title: Strawberry Video Player
apps.summary: Offline video player, HDMI diagnostics and test patterns for AV professionals
apps.description:
Strawberry Video Player turns the CardputerZero into a tool for AV professionals. It works completely offline: no network is needed.

Offline video player: plays every video in ~/Videos in alphabetical order and loops, on HDMI at up to 1080p (hardware decoding where the Pi supports it) or on the built-in LCD, with sound following the picture.

HDMI diagnostic tool: press i to see what the connected display reports, on the LCD: its name, maker and product code, the active mode, color range and bit depth, audio formats, link status, CEC address, and native and supported modes. The page also appears for a few seconds whenever HDMI is connected.

Test pattern generator: press t for color bars, gray steps, a 1:1 geometry pattern (square and circle), a convergence grid, and an audio and sync test with left, right and both-channel tones. Keys z, x, c and f choose the pattern. Keys 1 to 8 set the display's aspect ratio (16:9, 16:10, 4:3, 5:4, 1:1, 2.35:1, 2.21:1, 21:9) for displays that stretch the picture. Patterns work even when there are no videos on the card.

USB drives: plug in a drive (FAT32, exFAT, NTFS or ext4) and the videos on it play, read-only; remove it and playback returns to ~/Videos.

Keys: Tab LCD/HDMI, q/Space play-pause, z/x previous, c/f next, w/e skip 30 s, s/d volume, a mute, l loop one/all, p subtitles (HDMI), 0/o LCD off/on, 1-8 aspect ratio, i HDMI diagnostics, t test patterns, h help, Esc quit.

Smooth full-screen 1080p on HDMI works out of the box on the stock image: the player briefly stops the desktop while it plays, using the device's passwordless sudo for that one purpose.

apps.title: Sudoku
apps.summary: 键盘党的数独：唯一解生成、三档难度、笔记、计时最佳纪录
apps.description:
为 M5Stack CardputerZero 打造的键盘数独 —— 物理键盘直操，随开随玩。

每一局都由内置生成器现场出题：位掩码回溯生成全解，再逐格挖洞并校验唯一性，保证恰好一个答案，绝不出现无解或多解局。

【三档难度】
· 轻松：40 个提示数，茶余饭后
· 标准：32 个提示数，正式挑战
· 挑战：26 个提示数，硬核推理

【玩法特性】
· 笔记候选：小字标记每格可能的数字，反复按同数字切换
· 即时反馈：填错标红、同数高亮、所在行列宫淡色提示
· 余数统计：每个数字还剩几个一目了然，快速找到突破口
· 计时纪录：用时与最佳成绩按难度分别保存，挑战自我
· 音效：合成短音零素材，落子/错误/通关各有提示音

【按键说明】
F/X/Z/C（键帽丝印方向键）移动光标
1-9 填数字（笔记模式下写候选）
0 / 退格 擦除
n 笔记模式开关
r 重开一局    d 切换难度
Fn+S / Fn+D 调节系统音量    Fn+A 静音
Esc 退出

开源：github.com/dbrhspyjkf-code/sudokuzero

apps.summary: Offline neural text-to-speech: type English or Ukrainian, hear it spoken.
apps.description:
TalkToMe turns the Cardputer Zero into a talking device: type text, pick a voice and hear it spoken on the built-in speaker. Synthesis runs entirely on the device with a compact neural TTS engine, so your text never leaves it: no network, no account, no cloud service.

Voices: Linda (English) and Mykyta, Oleksa, Tetiana and Serhiy (Ukrainian). All voices ship with the app and nothing is downloaded at run time.

Numbers, dates, times, money and percentages are read out in words with correct grammar, in Ukrainian down to case endings and word stress. Ukrainian text is shown with the stress the voice used.

Keys: Enter opens the text editor with an on-screen keyboard map, Alt switches between English and Ukrainian input, Enter speaks and Esc stops. Space reads a random sample line. In the editor, hold Fn+Z/C to move by character, Fn+Ctrl+Z/C by word and Fn+F/X to jump to the start or end. Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V copy and paste through the system clipboard.

apps.title: Telega
apps.summary: Unofficial Telegram client: chats, photos, voice messages, EN/UA typing.
apps.description:
Telega is an unofficial Telegram client built for the Cardputer Zero keyboard and 320x170 screen. Sign in by scanning a QR code with the Telegram app on your phone, or with a phone number and login code.

The chat list follows your Telegram folders (New, All and your own tabs), shows pinned, muted and unread state, and searches by name as you type. Open a chat to read history with read ticks and day separators, reply, react, delete, view and save photos, send images from the device, and record or play voice messages on the built-in microphone and speaker. Forum groups open as a list of threads.

Typing uses a full-screen editor with an on-screen keyboard map: Alt switches between English and Ukrainian (transliterated from the Latin keys), SYM lights up the symbols each key will type, Fn+Z/C and Fn+F/X move the cursor, and Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V go through the system clipboard. Every screen lists its keys at the bottom, and Fn+J saves a screenshot.

Telega is not affiliated with Telegram. It is built on TDLib and uses its own application credentials; your account data stays on the device in your home directory.

apps.title: Tyrell Video
apps.summary: Local video with subtitles, audio tracks and handheld or HDMI playback
apps.description:
Play local videos on the CardputerZero's built-in display, or send the movie to a dedicated HDMI screen while keeping controls on the handheld.

Browse folders and mounted media without a full-card scan. Choose audio tracks and common text subtitles, including matching external SRT files. Subtitles start off. HDMI playback prefers TV audio and falls back to onboard sound when necessary.

Enter opens a file. Space pauses or resumes. Left/Right seek 10 seconds; Up/Down change volume. O selects the display, T opens audio/subtitle tracks, V selects audio output, M mutes, Esc returns to the browser, and Q exits to APPLaunch. W/A/S/D provide navigation fallbacks.

Version 0.1.7 adds one software-decoder retry per file load for a specific HDMI buffer-pool activation failure after hardware decoding. The retry preserves playback position, selected tracks and play/pause intent. Software decoding may be slower, and demanding files may need computer-side conversion.

Requires a CardputerZero running compatible Debian 13 ARM64 software with APPLaunch, GStreamer 1.26 and systemd 253 or newer. Dedicated HDMI playback temporarily releases the stock desktop and restores it on exit. The package installs a restricted nonroot console helper. Codec availability and smooth playback depend on the file. Streaming, playlists and saved playback positions are not included.

The screenshots are rendered UI previews. A tested 1920x816, 24 fps H.264/AAC source completed more than ten minutes of HDMI playback with captions, including recovery from one controlled startup allocation failure using software decoding. The tested TV output mode was 720p. Other file profiles can have different performance limits.

Flash LAB5 hardware and compatible platforms from the Tab5, Cardputer, Cardputer ADV, and CoreS3 families—without using a computer. apps.title: Voice Input
apps.summary: Use your voice to enter text on Cardputer Zero.
apps.description:
Use your voice to enter text on Cardputer Zero. Press Fn + V to start recording, speak, then press it again to insert the transcription into the current input field. Text is not sent or executed automatically.

Choose DeepSeek or OpenAI, and switch between providers with configured keys using Shift + Fn + V. Manage keys, start or stop the service, and open the shortcut guide in the settings app. REC and ASR indicators show recording and transcription progress; OK and FAIL show the outcome. Recording stops automatically after 15 seconds and is canceled if the original input target changes or closes. Transcription requests time out after 10 seconds.

Tested with ZClaw and the CLI/ST terminal. Compatibility may vary across apps and system versions. Requires an internet connection and an API key. Audio is sent to the selected provider, whose pricing and data policies apply. OpenAI automatically detects the spoken language.

zh-CN.title: 语音输入
zh-CN.summary: 在 Cardputer Zero 上使用语音输入文字。
zh-CN.description:
在 Cardputer Zero 上使用语音输入文字。按 Fn + V 开始录音，说话后再次按下，将识别结果插入当前输入框。文字不会自动发送或执行。

支持 DeepSeek 和 OpenAI，可按 Shift + Fn + V 在已配置密钥的服务商之间切换。在设置页面管理密钥、启停服务或查看快捷键指南。REC 和 ASR 标记表示录音与识别状态；OK 和 FAIL 表示结果。录音最长 15 秒，原输入目标发生变化或关闭时会取消录音。识别请求超时时间为 10 秒。

已在 ZClaw 和 CLI/ST 终端测试；兼容性可能因应用和系统版本而异。需要网络连接及服务商 API Key。音频会发送给所选服务商，其收费标准和数据政策适用。OpenAI 自动识别所说语言。

ja.title: 音声入力
ja.summary: Cardputer Zero で音声をテキストに変換して入力。
ja.description:
Cardputer Zero で音声をテキストに変換して入力できます。Fn + V を押して録音を始め、話し終えたらもう一度押すと、認識結果が現在の入力欄に挿入されます。テキストが自動で送信・実行されることはありません。

DeepSeek と OpenAI に対応し、Shift + Fn + V でキーを設定済みのサービスを切り替えられます。設定画面では API キーの管理、サービスの開始・停止、ショートカットの確認ができます。REC と ASR は録音・認識中、OK と FAIL は結果を示します。録音は最大 15 秒で、入力先が変わるか閉じられるとキャンセルされます。認識リクエストのタイムアウトは 10 秒です。

ZClaw と CLI/ST ターミナルで動作を確認しています。アプリやシステムのバージョンによって互換性は異なります。インターネット接続と API キーが必要です。音声は選択したサービスに送信され、その料金とデータポリシーが適用されます。OpenAI は話された言語を自動検出します。

apps.title: USB Screen
apps.summary: Turn a tiny MSU2 USB screen into a live dashboard for your CardputerZero
apps.description:
Plug a small MSU2 / MSU2_MINI USB screen (160x80) into the CardputerZero and this app turns it into an always-on dashboard. A background service keeps it updated; the on-device settings app (open it from the launcher) picks what it shows and previews each page live on the built-in LCD.

Pages you can switch on: system stats (CPU, memory, temperature), a clock, network/WiFi status, home BLE sensors (reads the Wireless Toolbox sensor cache if you run it), your own custom text, the output of a shell command, an image, a live mirror of the CardputerZero's own screen, any program on its own virtual screen (via cage), and the Raspberry Pi desktop. Tap the screen's touch button to flip pages, or auto-rotate them. Brightness, 180-degree flip and frame rate are all adjustable.

The background service runs as you (never root) and only ever talks to its own CH32X035 screen by USB id, so it never grabs other USB serial gadgets.

可开关的页面:系统状态(CPU、内存、温度)、时钟、网络/WiFi 状态、家里 BLE 传感器(装了「无线工具箱」时会读它的传感器缓存)、自定义文字、某条 shell 命令的输出、图片、本机屏幕实时镜像、在独立虚拟屏上运行的任意程序(用 cage)、以及树莓派桌面。点一下小屏上的触摸按钮翻页,也可以自动轮播。亮度、画面 180 度倒转、帧率都能调。

后台服务以你的身份运行(绝不用 root),而且只按 USB id 认自己那块 CH32X035 小屏,绝不会去抢占别的 USB 串口设备。

apps.title: Wireless Toolbox
apps.summary: Net tools, WiFi audit, BLE sensors, tracker watch and a BLE sniffer in one app
apps.description:
Wireless Toolbox puts five wireless and network tools behind one menu on the CardputerZero.

• Net Tools — ping monitors, WiFi scan, LAN discovery (ARP + mDNS), port probe. Works out of the box.
• Home Sensors — read nearby BLE sensor beacons (temperature, humidity, door, motion) over the built-in Bluetooth. Works out of the box.
• Tracker Guard — spot unknown AirTag-style trackers that follow you, over the built-in Bluetooth. Works out of the box.
• WiFi Audit — scan 802.11, watch for deauth attacks and more. Needs a USB monitor-mode WiFi adapter; the built-in wlan0 stays your uplink.
• BLE Sniffer — capture Bluetooth LE packets to a Wireshark pcap. Needs an nRF Sniffer dongle.

The three built-in-radio tools run on any unit; the two that need extra hardware show a clear 'plug it in' screen when it isn't found. Key 4 (or Esc) backs out of any tool to the menu.

zh-CN.title: 无线工具箱
zh-CN.summary: 网络工具 + WiFi 分析 + 蓝牙传感器 + 防追踪 + 蓝牙抓包,五合一
zh-CN.description:
无线工具箱把五个无线/网络工具放进 CardputerZero 的一个菜单里。

• Net Tools 网络工具 —— Ping 监控、WiFi 扫描、局域网发现(ARP+mDNS)、端口探测。开箱即用。
• Home Sensors 智能家居 —— 用内置蓝牙读周围 BLE 传感器(温湿度、门磁、人体感应)。开箱即用。
• Tracker Guard 防追踪 —— 用内置蓝牙发现跟着你走的可疑 AirTag 类追踪器。开箱即用。
• WiFi Audit WiFi 分析 —— 扫 802.11、监测 deauth 攻击等。需外接 USB 监听网卡,内置 wlan0 仍做上网。
• BLE Sniffer 蓝牙抓包 —— 把 BLE 数据包抓成 Wireshark pcap。需 nRF 嗅探器 dongle。

三个用内置射频的工具任何机器都能用;两个要外接硬件的,在没插硬件时会给出清晰的「请插入」提示。任意工具里按 4(或 Esc)返回菜单。

zh-CN.summary: 网络工具 + WiFi 分析 + 蓝牙传感器 + 防追踪 + 蓝牙抓包,五合一
zh-CN.description:
无线工具箱把五个无线/网络工具放进 CardputerZero 的一个菜单里。

• Net Tools 网络工具 —— Ping 监控、WiFi 扫描、局域网发现(ARP+mDNS)、端口探测。开箱即用。
• Home Sensors 智能家居 —— 用内置蓝牙读周围 BLE 传感器(温湿度、门磁、人体感应)。开箱即用。
• Tracker Guard 防追踪 —— 用内置蓝牙发现跟着你走的可疑 AirTag 类追踪器。开箱即用。
• WiFi Audit WiFi 分析 —— 扫 802.11、监测 deauth 攻击等。需外接 USB 监听网卡,内置 wlan0 仍做上网。
• BLE Sniffer 蓝牙抓包 —— 把 BLE 数据包抓成 Wireshark pcap。需 nRF 嗅探器 dongle。

三个用内置射频的工具任何机器都能用;两个要外接硬件的,在没插硬件时会给出清晰的「请插入」提示。任意工具里按 4(或 Esc)返回菜单。

apps.title: Wasteland
apps.summary: Host a co-op wasteland hex crawl for up to five phones on your Wi-Fi.
apps.description:
Wasteland turns the CardputerZero into the server for a co-op survival crawl across a hex map of ruins, ash dunes, rust forests and glass fields. Up to five players join from their own phones: each opens the address shown on the screen in a phone browser, claims a survivor and plays from there. No app to install on the phones and no account.

The survivors scavenge, trade, craft and keep each other alive against hunger, thirst, radiation, weather and a threat clock that runs down every day. Encounters, trading caravans, wildfires, booby traps, quakes, floods and the Creeping Doom come and go while the day turns.

The main quest is the Meridian Engine. Everyone says the war broke the world, but that is not the whole of it: a prewar research complex built a planetary resonator, and during the exchange its control system fired every node at once and sealed this region into a loop, with its radiation, its weather, its radio echoes and pieces of its people caught inside. Reactivating the Engine is the only way out. Nobody agrees on what it is: a machine, a ritual, a prison, or a mirror that shows you what you already believe. One of its sites is the Null Camp, where eleven cots stand round the floor of an observation gallery with no gallery around it, the kettle is still warm, and the roster has eleven names but you keep counting twelve.

On the open ground, Machine Gun Kane drives a rusted army jeep with a machine gun on the windshield. He shoots at anyone caught out in the open, and he always asks a question first. You cannot fight him, only get out of his way; the camps he leaves each dawn tell his story in five chapters.

Out in the scrub, Jack the Romper sits by a crashed helicopter in a very pink romper, trying not to cry. Bring back the Intimidating Mask he left at the fungus-ridden gas station and he builds you a Motorbike out of the wreck. Later he turns up in a settlement running Jack's Friend Chicken, a fryer over a burning tyre with a queue of eleven survivors and a goat. Ride up on the bike he built and regulars don't wait.

The CardputerZero's own screen is the table: it shows each of the game's six pages (Road, Chronicle, Stash, Odds, Waste, Admired) at full size, and beside it a column with the day, the weather, the threat clock and a dog tag with a life bar for every seated player. Traps, ghouls and deaths take the whole screen while they play: the jaws snap shut, and when a survivor goes down the Doom laughs. While nobody is seated it shows the address to join.

Keys follow the signs printed on the keyboard: C (or Enter, Space, PG DN) goes to the next page, A, S and D set the speaker volume, F and X move between a page's picture and its text, V zooms, K goes home, H shows the address and the keys, and ESC held saves and quits.

The game is served over your local network on port 80 (8080 if 80 cannot be opened), so the CardputerZero and the phones must be on the same network. The world is saved on the device. Nothing is sent to the internet.

apps.title: WiFi USB
apps.summary: Cyberpunk-styled  utility for M5Stack CardputerZero to manage Wi-Fi adapters
apps.description:
CardputerZero Wi-Fi USB Manager (WiFi USB in APPLaunch) provides a native, fast 320 × 170 graphical interface designed specifically for the CardputerZero's physical TCA8418 keyboard and MIPI/ST7789 LCD (/dev/fb_lcd) so you can:

Auto-detect & prioritize USB Wi-Fi adapters ([USB] vs [INT] badges, reading real USB vendor/product strings and kernel drivers via sysfs).
Switch interfaces on the fly (wlan1 ↔ wlan0) and inspect per-adapter state, active SSID, and IPv4 address.
Scan 2.4 GHz & 5 GHz networks on the selected adapter with live signal bars, security badges (OPN / LCK), channel info, and circular marquee scrolling for long SSIDs and adapter names.
Connect with per-adapter NetworkManager profiles (<ifname>-<ssid>) so your USB adapter and built-in Wi-Fi can connect independently to the same or different networks without colliding.

apps.description: Import a WireGuard tunnel from a .conf file or by scanning its QR code with the camera, then connect with one key. Shows tunnel address, DNS and traffic, and can connect at boot. Never runs as root; private keys stay root-only. Adding or deleting tunnels asks for your password. Needs NetworkManager (default on the official image). WireGuard is a registered trademark of Jason A. Donenfeld.

apps.title: XIANG
apps.summary: 中国象棋 · 三档开源 AI 与六位码联机 / Chinese chess with AI and LAN play
apps.description:
简体中文
在 Cardputer Zero 下中国象棋。支持离线人机、同机双人和局域网联机，提供简体中文和英文界面。方向键只在当前可走的己方棋子间跳转，选中后高亮棋子并跳转至合法落点。短按 Esc 或 Backspace 取消选棋。

在 Zero 主菜单进入「设置」，选中「语言」，按 Enter 或左右方向键（Z / C）切换「简体中文」和「English」。网页端点击右上角的 English 或简体中文按钮。

离线人机使用 Morning Yellow（象棋百科全书 / xqbase）的开源「象棋小巫师」XQWLight 引擎，沿用入门、业余、专业三档。随包提供未修改的引擎源文件和许可证。XIANG 采用 GPL-3.0-or-later，内含 XQWLight JavaScript 文件采用 GPL-2.0-or-later。

局域网联机使用 6 位房间码，配对需要联网，走棋通过 WebRTC 直连。联机网页：https://xiangzero.vercel.app/

English
Play Chinese chess on Cardputer Zero against an offline engine, with a friend on one device, or over your LAN. Choose Simplified Chinese or English. Arrow keys jump between movable pieces or legal destinations. Press Esc or Backspace to deselect.

On Zero, open Settings from the main menu, highlight Language, and press Enter or Left/Right (Z / C) to switch between English and Simplified Chinese. On the web, use the English / 简体中文 button in the upper-right corner.

Offline computer play uses the open-source XiangQi Wizard Light (XQWLight) engine by Morning Yellow (xqbase), with its original Beginner, Amateur, and Professional levels. The package includes the unmodified engine source and license. XIANG is GPL-3.0-or-later. The bundled XQWLight JavaScript files are GPL-2.0-or-later.

LAN mode uses a 6-digit room code. Pairing requires internet access, and moves travel directly over WebRTC. Web app: https://xiangzero.vercel.app/

Source / 源码 · https://github.com/xu-c/XIANG
Engine / 引擎 · https://github.com/xqbase/xqwlight

apps.description:
Browse websites, search the web and download files. Zero Browser is designed for the Cardputer Zero small screen and built-in keyboard. Choose QtWebKit for general browsing with Javascript support, or NetSurf for lightweight browsing on simpler websites.

Zero Browser is experimental. Some websites may reject this unfamiliar browser or fail to load due to JavaScript incompatibilities. apps.title: Zero Cellular
apps.summary: 4G LTE Phone, SMS & Data client for Cardputer Zero with DJI(QDC507) 4G module
apps.description:
Zero Cellular is a standalone native CardputerZero application for DJI(QDC507) 4G LTE cellular modules. Built directly on the Linux framebuffer (/dev/fb_lcd) and evdev with FreeType-hinted system fonts (DejaVu Sans + Noto Sans CJK SC Medium), it runs completely unprivileged with low memory footprint.
Features:
  - VoLTE Voice Calls: Dialer, recent call log, incoming ringtone & alert, live call timer, DTMF keypad, instant mic mute, and live speaker volume / mic gain controls via software Blackman-sinc RateBridge and PipeWire audio routing.
  - SMS Messaging: Conversation list with unread indicators, multi-part GSM-7 & UCS-2 (CJK) send/receive, wrapped chat bubbles, and inline reply composer.
  - Mobile Data & Telemetry: Live operator, LTE band, RSRP signal bars, battery, and clock; toggle usb0 mobile data cleanly without interrupting VoLTE or SMS.
  - Modem Debug & Factory Setup (Dbg tab): 7-point readiness checklist (USB ID, AT/SIM, IMS/VoLTE, ECM, Root ADB, UAC, Voice PCM), interactive AT command console with presets, and one-click provisioning for new QDC507-GL modules.
Zero Cellular 是专为 CardputerZero 打造的独立原生 4G LTE 蜂窝通信应用（适配 DJI(QDC507) 模组），基于原生 /dev/fb_lcd 帧缓冲与 evdev 键盘构建，使用FreeType 像素微调系统字体（DejaVu Sans + Noto Sans CJK SC Medium），全程以普通用户权限低内存运行。
主要功能：
  - VoLTE 高清语音通话：支持拨号盘、通话记录、来电振铃与提醒、通话计时、DTMF 按键、实时静音及扬声器音量/麦克风增益调节，内置 16-tap Blackman-sinc 重采样与 PipeWire 音频路由。
  - 短信收发：支持中英文长短信（GSM-7 / UCS-2）收发与自动重组、未读提醒、自动换行气泡对话与快捷回复。
  - 移动数据与状态监测：顶栏实时显示运营商、LTE 频段、RSRP 信号格数、电量与时间，支持在不中断 VoLTE 与短信的情况下开关 usb0 移动数据。
  - 模组调试与出厂配置（Dbg 页面）：内置 7 项就绪状态诊断、交互式 AT 指令控制台（含常用预设）以及面向未初始化的 DJI(QDC507-GL) 模组的一键/分步初始化工具
apps.depends: libc6, fonts-dejavu-core

apps.title: Zero Music
apps.summary: Zero Music is a music player designed for Cardputer Zero.
apps.description:
Zero Music is a keyboard-first music player built for the Cardputer Zero's 320x170 screen.

It plays music stored on the device and, through third-party MyGo Music-compatible plugins, can browse and play network sources. Zero Music does not provide, host, bundle, or distribute any music catalogue, streaming service, or credentials. Local playback works without plugins; network playback requires a plugin that you install and configure yourself.

Features:
- Local library with folders, albums, artists, playlists, likes and recent history.
- MyGo Music-compatible plugin manager: discovery, install/remove, QR sign-in where supported, per-plugin settings and process permission.
- Album art, progress and volume controls, scrolling lyrics.
- Played songs are cached on disk and reused without downloading again.
- Full keyboard operation: Q/W/E transport, arrow seek/volume, Fn shortcuts and built-in help.
- Open source under AGPL-3.0-only.

Plugins are separate third-party software, not part of MyGo Music or Zero Music. This project does not control, review, endorse or support them. Find plugins at https://music.egoist.dev/plugins/ or build your own using the guide at https://github.com/egoist/mygo-music#publishing-a-plugin. You are responsible for ensuring that the plugins you use and the music you access are legal in your jurisdiction.


Zero Music 是面向 Cardputer Zero 320×170 屏幕打造的键盘优先音乐播放器。

它可播放设备上的本地音乐，并可通过第三方 MyGo Music 兼容插件浏览和播放网络音源。Zero Music 本身不提供、托管、捆绑或分发任何音乐目录、流媒体服务或凭据；本地播放无需插件，网络播放需要自行安装并配置插件。

功能：
- 本地音乐库：文件夹、专辑、艺人、播放列表、喜欢和最近播放。
- MyGo Music 兼容插件管理：发现、安装/删除、扫码登录、插件设置和进程权限。
- 专辑封面、进度与音量控制、滚动歌词。
- 播放过的歌曲缓存在本地，再次播放不重复下载。
- 全键盘操作：Q/W/E 播放控制、方向键快进/音量、Fn 快捷键和内置帮助。
- 以 AGPL-3.0-only 开源。

插件是独立第三方软件，不属于 MyGo Music 或 Zero Music；本项目不控制、审查、背书或支持插件。可在 https://music.egoist.dev/plugins/ 寻找插件，或参考 https://github.com/egoist/mygo-music#publishing-a-plugin 制作自己的插件。使用插件和访问音乐时，请自行确认符合当地法律及服务条款。

首次使用需要自己的网易云音乐开放平台 App ID 和 Private Key。在同一局域网内用手机或电脑打开 Zero 显示的配置网页，保存凭据后扫码登录。

apps.description:

Settings (S): choose English and/or Chinese, and Tech, Life and/or General news; each combination has its own sources (Hacker News, The Verge, BBC, NYT, CBC, RTHK, unwire.hk, iThome and more). Also sets how fast headlines rotate. My feeds adds your own RSS feeds: type a feed or website address on the keyboard.

Keys: F/X previous/next (Z/C left/right), OK details (up/down scroll a line, left/right a page), P pause, R refresh, S settings, hold ESC 3 seconds to exit. Headlines are cached for offline viewing.

A watchlist of live prices with an intraday sparkline and the day's change for each stock. Press ENTER for a K-line (candlestick) chart with volume; switch the candle period between 1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 1D, 1W and 1M with Z/C.

apps.description:
Inspired by minichord and the Suzuki Omnichord, ZeroChord turns your CardputerZero keyboard into a pocket instrument. Choose a chord with one hand and pick or strum its notes with the other.

Play solo or bring in a backing band: Chord, Arp, Pad, Bass and Drums layers follow your chords, with optional swing. Seven editable presets, from Dream to Dance, give you different sounds and rhythms to start with.

Try it
1. Press 8 for C major.
2. Pick notes with Z, X, C, V, B, N or M. Press K or L to strum.
3. Press O to mute or mix the backing layers.

User guide (https://github.com/momo20261121/ZeroChord/blob/main/docs/USER_GUIDE.md)

*** Mouse and HDMI output recommended ***

Zero DAW turns the M5Stack CardputerZero into a complete pattern-based music studio. Program beats on the channel rack, write melodies in the piano roll, arrange songs in the playlist and mix with reverb, delay and drive, all from the keyboard.

It comes with 17 instrument plugins, each with its own faceplate and live waveform. They include Acid303 with slide and accent, SuperSaw, FM, wavetable, formant vocals, a string machine, additive, CZ-style phase distortion, organ, E-piano, physical strings and bells, chiptune, a drum synth and a sampler. That's 184 sounds ready to play, and you can add your own.

Plug in a USB MIDI keyboard to play and record live, with knobs for cutoff, resonance and more. Zero DAW can also sync to MIDI clock or drive your hardware synths. Plug in HDMI and you get the Studio View on your TV, with the built-in screen becoming a live companion display. Export your tracks to WAV. Eight demo songs show what it can do, from acid house and drum & bass to trap, funk, ambient and chiptune.

Features

- Channel rack step sequencer, piano roll, 8-track playlist, 16-channel mixer.
- 17 instrument plugins with their own faceplates and live waveforms: TriOsc, FM Zero, DrumSynth, Sampler, Plucker, SuperSaw, Organ, E-Piano, Acid303, ChipTune, Modal, Wavetron, VoxBox, Ensemble, Additron, PD-Zero, MIDI Out.
- 184 built-in sounds, all synthesised on the device - add your own presets and WAV samples, or record from the microphone.
- USB MIDI keyboards and controllers: play, record, knobs for cutoff, resonance, attack and more; MIDI clock in and out.
- HDMI Studio View: rack, playlist, piano roll and plugins side by side on your monitor, with a live companion display on the built-in screen.
- Reverb, delay, drive, tone and a master limiter.
- Export songs to WAV.
- Eight demo songs: Acid Zero, Night Drive, Chip Dreams, Lo-Fi Keys, Jungle Zero, Trap 808, Vox Funk, Ambient Glass.

apps.title: ZeroPower
apps.summary: Battery saver: live power draw, turn off Ethernet, HDMI, BT, services
apps.description:
Make the Cardputer Zero last longer. See the live power draw from the battery gauge, then turn off for good what a handheld does not need, and undo it just as easily.

- Battery: average draw over the last 30 s, charge, voltage and time left, with the last minute as bars. R restarts the average, so you can see what each setting saves.
- Hardware: internal USB Ethernet (On / Auto-suspend / Off, ~90 mA less), Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, the HDMI desktop (lightdm), the GPU memory split (16 MB is enough for the built-in screen: 48 MB more RAM), a CPU speed cap, the status LED and the 5 V outputs of the Grove port and the GPIO header. With Desk Mode, its HDMI desktop can close itself once HDMI is unplugged.
- Services, each on its own switch: Tailscale, NFS client (rpcbind), Avahi (.local names), daily apt updates, the man page index, the disk scrub timer and system logs in RAM.
- Power saving (zeropowerd, a service running as the device user, not root): screen off sleeps the sound card and pauses the launcher (each one on its own switch) after a delay you choose (a key wakes it), quiet launcher (no key sounds), a clean power-off at low battery (with an on-screen warning first; plugging in the charger cancels it), and a screen timeout that turns the screen off after a few minutes without a key, as a safety net for when the launcher or an app leaves it on.

Settings stay in the system itself and survive reboots. Uninstalling ZeroPower puts every changed setting back. System changes go through a small helper that accepts a fixed list of settings, run with the device user's sudo: passwordless as set up by Raspberry Pi Imager, or ZeroPower asks for the password on screen (never stored); no sudoers file is installed.

Measured on a Cardputer Zero with the screen off: 301 mA -> 209 mA just with Ethernet auto-suspend. Ideas and first measurements from cz-battery-saver by InstantComet (MIT).

apps.description:
ZeroRadio turns the CardputerZero into a pocket receiver. Plug an RTL-SDR dongle (for example the RTL-SDR Blog V4) into the USB-A port and open the hub.

Every decoder runs on the device, with no computer or network. Set your position by city, coordinates or GPS (Cap LoRa-1262-GPS or a USB GPS). Press H in any app for its help. The package bundles readsb and AIS-catcher (GPL-3.0); see Credits in the app.

apps.title: ZeroRemote
apps.summary: Use the Cardputer from your phone: live screen, keys and files (needs Tailscale)
apps.description:
REQUIRES TAILSCALE. ZeroRemote only works through Tailscale: install Tailscale on the Cardputer Zero and on your phone (or computer) and sign both into the same tailnet. Without Tailscale it does nothing: the service only listens on the device's Tailscale address, so it is not reachable on your Wi-Fi or from the internet, and the Remote app just shows "Waiting for Tailscale".

Use the Cardputer Zero from your phone: see its screen live in the browser, type on it and share files.

- Remote screen: the 320x170 screen, sharp and live (only the rows that change are sent, up to 20 fps), with buttons for Esc, Tab, Enter, arrows, delete and space, your phone's keyboard for typing, and the battery level.
- Touch the picture: it wakes the screen and unlocks the launcher; on the launcher, the sides move between apps and the centre opens one. Inside apps a touch sends nothing.
- File sharing: Music, Pictures, Videos, Downloads, Documents and GPS tracks. Upload from the phone (never overwrites), download, open photos, audio, video and text in the browser, create folders and delete. Nothing outside those folders.
- The Remote app shows two switches (remote screen, file sharing; file sharing starts off) and a QR code with the address: scan it with the phone camera. The same switches are on the web page.

Only devices in your own tailnet can connect (anything outside 100.64.0.0/10 is refused), so nobody on the same Wi-Fi can see it. While nobody is connected it does nothing. The web page is in Spanish. The service runs as the device user (not root), in Python with only the standard library.

apps.title: ZeroSend
apps.summary: ZeroSend: share files and text with LocalSend apps nearby (unofficial client)
apps.description:
ZeroSend is a file sharing app for the CardputerZero that speaks the open LocalSend protocol, so it works with the free LocalSend app on Android, iOS, Windows, macOS and Linux. No cloud, no account: files go straight over your Wi-Fi, encrypted (HTTPS).

**Receive**
- Open ZeroSend and it shows up in LocalSend on your phone or computer under the Cardputer's name.
- When someone sends files, ZeroSend shows who is sending, the file names and sizes; Y accepts, N declines. Or set it to accept everything.
- Files and folders are saved to ~/Downloads, with progress and speed on screen.
- Text messages from LocalSend pop up on the screen; S saves one as a file.

**Send**
- Nearby devices running LocalSend appear in the list. Pick one, then send files and folders (Space marks several) or type a text message.
- A adds a device by IP address or name, for networks without multicast, such as Tailscale. Added devices are remembered.

**Setup** (S): the name other devices see, ask first or accept all, address and certificate fingerprint.

ZeroSend only runs while it is open: close it and nothing listens on the network.

Keys: F/X move, Enter send/open, Space mark, Y send marked, A add IP, R rescan, S setup, Esc back.

Unofficial: ZeroSend is an independent implementation of the LocalSend protocol and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the LocalSend project.

apps.description:
ZeroSky shows the real sky, live. It computes the stars, constellations, planets, Sun and Moon for the time and your position, and draws them in the direction you point the CardputerZero.

- Sky: 5,070 stars, 605 Messier, NGC and IC objects, constellation figures with their names, and the Solar System. The star limit follows daylight and twilight.
- Pointing: the IMU follows the device. Calibrate the compass outdoors with a guided figure 8 and it also finds true north; without it, align north with the arrows.
- Find: type a name, and an arrow and rising beeps lead you to the object.
- Camera: draw the sky over the live image and align it with the stars you see.
- Red night theme, blue day theme, location by city, coordinates or GPS.

Everything runs on the device, with no network. Press H for help in seven languages. Pointing accuracy and the camera lens field (an estimated 62.2 degrees) are not yet measured against the night sky.

apps.title: ZeroSub
apps.summary: Sub-GHz, infrared, NFC and IMU toolkit for the Cap CC1101, Flipper compatible
apps.description:
ZeroSub turns the CardputerZero and the M5Stack Cap CC1101 into a pocket radio and sensor tool.

Sub-GHz (CC1101): frequency analyzer, signal meter, Read and Read RAW captures on the 17 Flipper Zero default channels with AM270/AM650/FM238/FM476 presets, a saved-signal library, manual key entry, and Send limited to the EU licence-free bands.

Infrared: learn remotes, save them and send them again. Flipper zero compatible.

NFC (ST25R3916): read NFC-A, NFC-B, FeliCa and NFC-V (ISO 15693) tags and show the URL or text they hold; write saved NTAG and MIFARE Ultralight tags to blank ones and emulate them to a reader. NFC support is new and still being tested on hardware. Flipper zero compatible.

IMU: live motion readings from the BMI270 (acceleration, rotation, tilt, temperature), a compass with heading dial from the BMM150, and a bubble level.

Web Files: a small web file manager for your home folder, running while its page is open. Open the address shown on the device from a browser on the same network, log in with the PIN on screen, then browse, download, upload, rename and delete files, or install a .deb package.

Signals, remotes and tags are stored as Flipper Zero .sub, .ir and .nfc files, so they can be copied between ZeroSub and a Flipper in either direction. Requires the M5Stack Cap CC1101.

apps.title: ZeroTag
apps.summary: Amiibo library and emulator for the CardputerZero with the NFC Cap
apps.description:
ZeroTag turns the CardputerZero and its Cap CC1101 (ST25R3916) into an amiibo library and emulator.

- Library of your own 540-byte backups (put them in ~/amiibo), recognised automatically, with signature check.
- Catalogue of 954 characters: create blank, correctly signed amiibo.
- NTAG215 emulation, verified with a Flipper Zero and a Nintendo Switch 2. What the game writes is saved to the file (autosave), signatures stay valid.
- Optional UID rotation after each read, keeping the data.
- Text search (names, series, ids; accents ignored), favourites, recent list and a scan of your real figures.
- Optional online update (off by default): Settings > Online downloads the public amiiboapi.org list so newly announced amiibo appear marked NEW or SOON. Nothing about you or the device is sent.
- Famicom-style interface in French, English, Japanese and Simplified Chinese, with in-app help (Fn+H).

Setup: copy your own key_retail.bin to ~/.zerotag/. After each boot the app offers to enable the Cap (it loads the SPI overlay with sudo: type your password on the keyboard, it is never stored); you can also run sudo /usr/lib/zerotag/cap-setup yourself. The app works fully offline. Amiibo thumbnails (artwork owned by Nintendo, from AmiiboAPI) are included for display only; your key_retail.bin is not.

Version 1.0 is a complete rewrite in Rust: statically linked, light on CPU and memory, with a demoscene manual in the settings.

apps.title: ZeroTracker
apps.summary: Pocket music tracker that reads and writes M8 songs and instruments
apps.description:
ZeroTracker is a music tracker for the CardputerZero, inspired by the M8 tracker and compatible with its song (.m8s) and instrument (.m8i) files.

- Eight tracks of songs, chains, phrases, instruments and tables.
- FM, WAV, MACRO (Braids models), HYPER and SAMPLER engines, with modulators, EQ and a sample editor that records from the microphone.
- Mixer with chorus, delay, reverb, master limiter and oscilloscopes.
- RENDER the song to WAV: the mix and a stem per track.
- LIBRARY: download packs of songs, instruments and samples on the device.
- Seven languages, themes, and a tooltip for every key (SYM + 4..8).

At the first start it creates ~/ZeroTracker with a demo song, instruments and a CC0 sample kit. APP > MANUAL shows a QR code to the getting-started guide. Not affiliated with Dirtywave.

apps.title: ZSynth
apps.summary: Pocket groovebox: synths, mic sampler, drums, patterns and songs
apps.description:
ZSynth turns the Cardputer Zero into a pocket groovebox.

Four tracks: a lead synth, a bass synth, a mic sampler and a drum kit. Each song has eight patterns, from 1 to 32 steps in any time signature (4/4, 3/4, 7/8, 6/8...), and a chain that plays them in order.

- Play live: arm recording and play along while the loop runs, with a metronome.
- Step editing: a drum-machine grid with accents, and a piano roll for writing notes and chords step by step.
- Sound design: shape each track on the Sound screen (wave, filter, envelope, detune), and hear changes as you play.
- Instrument library: 23 starter instruments. Browse them while your loop plays to hear each one in context, and save your own.
- Sampler: record up to 5 seconds from the built-in mic, or use the 18 starter samples (FM piano, harpsichord, marimba, kalimba, tenor sax, harmonica, gong and more) from the CC0 Versilian Community Sample Library, tuned to play across the keyboard.
- Comes with a demo song, night-shift: 87 seconds of dance-punk at 118 BPM.

Everything is saved as you go. Press Fn+H in the app for the key guide.
